characters.name: Asta
title: Black Bull Member
Bearer of the Five-Leaf Grimoire
Demon Dweller
The One Who Never Gives Up

head.eyes: Large, determined green eyes that sparkle with unwavering resolve and boundless energy. They narrow with fierce concentration in battle and widen with childlike wonder. His eyes reflect his never-say-die attitude.
head.nose: Small and rounded, often with a slight upturn. Usually has a smudge of dirt or sweat.
head.ears: Normal human ears, slightly prominent. Highly sensitive to insults about his height.
head.extra_facial_features: Short, messy ash-blonde hair with a single prominent cowlick at the front. He has a small, sharp face with a perpetual determined scowl or a wide, infectious grin. Several small scars from countless battles dot his cheeks and forehead. Notably, he has no eyebrows—a result of his intense physical training burning them off.

body.chest: Compact but incredibly muscular (42 inches) from years of intense physical training. His chest is a canvas of defined pectorals and washboard abs, all built through relentless conditioning to compensate for his lack of magic.
body.arms: Thick, powerful arms (16 inches) with bulging biceps and forearms that look like they belong to a bodybuilder. His hands are heavily calloused from gripping swords and doing thousands of push-ups daily.

lower_body.legs: Stocky, powerful legs (22 inches) with massive thighs that enable explosive speed and jumping power. His calves are thick and defined, allowing him to keep up with mages despite having no mana reinforcement.

armor_costume.head: No headgear, his wild hair is left free. Sometimes wears a black headband during training.

armor_costume.torso: Black Bulls robe—a black, long coat with silver buttons and the Black Bulls emblem (a bull skull) on the back. Underneath, he wears a simple sleeveless black shirt that shows off his muscular arms. The robe is often torn and battle-worn.

armor_costume.arms: His arms are bare, showing his impressive muscles. He wears black fingerless gloves that extend to his mid-forearm, with metal studs on the knuckles.

armor_costume.legs: Black pants tucked into brown combat boots with metal toe caps. A black belt with a silver buckle holds his pants.

armor_costume.accessories: His most important accessories: his anti-magic swords. He carries three: the Demon-Slayer Sword (a massive broadsword), the Demon-Dweller Sword (a longsword that can absorb and release magic), and the Demon-Destroyer Sword (a katana-like sword with a jagged edge). He also wears a small pouch containing his Black Bulls membership badge.

abilities.name: Anti-Magic
abilities.short_description: Asta's swords are imbued with Anti-Magic, allowing him to negate and nullify any magical attacks or effects they touch.
abilities.full_description: Because Asta has no magic, he wields swords that contain Anti-Magic, a power from the five-leaf grimoire's devil. When he swings his swords, they can slice through spells, cancel magical effects, and even dispel curses. The Anti-Magic can also flow through his body, granting him enhanced physical abilities and the power to resist magical control. He can also use his swords to reflect magic back at enemies.

abilities.name: Black Divider
abilities.short_description: Asta envelops his Demon-Slayer Sword in Anti-Magic, greatly increasing its size and power for a devastating swing.
abilities.full_description: By channeling a massive amount of Anti-Magic into his Demon-Slayer Sword, Asta transforms it into a giant black blade that can cleave through mountains. This technique puts immense strain on his body, but delivers overwhelming destructive power. It's his go-to finisher against powerful foes.

abilities.name: Black Meteorite
abilities.short_description: Asta uses Anti-Magic to propel himself like a meteor, delivering a rapid flurry of sword strikes.
abilities.full_description: Asta channels Anti-Magic through his legs and arms, launching himself at incredible speeds. He becomes a blur of motion, delivering dozens of sword strikes in an instant. The technique is unpredictable and hard to counter, as his Anti-Magic disrupts any magical defenses.

characters.name: Yuno
title: Golden Dawn Member
Bearer of the Four-Leaf Grimoire
Wind Spirit Host
The One Destined to Be Wizard King

head.eyes: Sharp, calm dark blue eyes that rarely show emotion. They hold quiet confidence and intense focus. In battle, they narrow with precision, tracking opponents with unerring accuracy.
head.nose: Straight, well-defined nose with a slight aristocratic quality.
head.ears: Normal human ears, slightly pointed like many elves. He has a small earring in his left ear—a golden hoop.
head.extra_facial_features: Short, dark navy blue hair with a prominent cowlick similar to Asta's, but neater. He has a handsome, chiseled face with high cheekbones and a perpetually calm expression. A small beauty mark under his left eye. His face rarely shows emotion, but occasionally a small smile for Asta.

body.chest: Lean and athletic (41 inches) with a well-proportioned, muscular build. His body is optimized for speed and agility rather than brute force.
body.arms: Slim but well-defined arms (15 inches) with visible muscle tone. His hands are elegant and precise, perfect for forming magical symbols.

lower_body.legs: Long, powerful legs (23 inches) that allow him to move with incredible speed and grace. He can create wind platforms to run through the air.

armor_costume.head: No headgear, his hair is always perfectly styled. Sometimes wears a silver circlet during formal Golden Dawn events.

armor_costume.torso: Golden Dawn robe—a long white coat with gold trim and the Golden Dawn emblem (a shining sun) on the back. Underneath, he wears a dark blue high-collared shirt and black pants. The outfit is always immaculate.

armor_costume.arms: His arms are covered by the robe's sleeves. He wears white gloves with gold embroidery.

armor_costume.legs: Black pants tucked into white boots with gold accents. A white belt with a gold buckle.

armor_costume.accessories: His four-leaf clover grimoire, always with him. A golden hoop earring in his left ear. He also carries a small pendant given to him by the church.

abilities.name: Wind Magic
abilities.short_description: Yuno controls wind with exceptional skill, using it for attack, defense, and mobility.
abilities.full_description: Yuno's magic allows him to manipulate wind at will. He can create slicing blades of wind (Wind Cutter), form defensive barriers, propel himself at incredible speeds, and even create a massive swirling tornado (Tornado Fist). His control is so precise that he can use wind to enhance his physical strikes or create platforms to stand on in mid-air. After receiving the Wind Spirit Sylph, his magic became even more powerful and refined.

abilities.name: Spirit of Zephyr
abilities.short_description: Yuno combines his magic with the Wind Spirit Sylph, creating a massive, sentient wind warrior.
abilities.full_description: By channeling Sylph's power, Yuno creates a colossal humanoid form made of swirling wind. This spirit fights alongside him, delivering devastating blows and protecting him. The Spirit of Zephyr can also merge with Yuno, granting him immense power and the ability to fly at supersonic speeds. It's his ultimate technique.

abilities.name: Star Magic
abilities.short_description: After inheriting the powers of the elves, Yuno gains Star Magic, allowing him to create and manipulate stars.
abilities.full_description: During the elf reincarnation arc, Yuno awakens a second magic attribute: Star Magic. This rare and powerful magic lets him create small stars that orbit him, which he can detonate or use to enhance his attacks. He can also create constellations that trap enemies or fire beams of light. Combined with his Wind Magic, he becomes nearly unstoppable.

characters.name: Noelle Silva
alias: The Failure of the Royal Family
title: Black Bull Member
Fourth Daughter of the Silva Family
Royal Heiress of the Clover Kingdom
The One Who Controls the Sea Dragon's Roar

head.eyes: Large, expressive aquamarine eyes that reveal her emotions—embarrassment, anger, determination, and growing confidence. They sparkle with hope when she looks at Asta.
head.nose: Small and delicate, befitting her royal status. Often red when she's flustered.
head.ears: Small, adorned with small pearl earrings.
head.extra_facial_features: Long, silvery-blue hair that reaches her waist, usually tied in two large side-tails with red ribbons. She has a beautiful, refined face with fair skin. Her expression is often a proud pout or a blush when embarrassed. A small beauty mark near her mouth.

body.chest: Slender and athletic (36 inches) with a developing figure. Her body is toned from training but still retains a royal elegance.
body.arms: Slender arms (13 inches) with delicate hands. She's not physically strong but uses magic for combat.

lower_body.legs: Long, shapely legs (22 inches) that she uses to kick Asta when he's being dense. Agile and quick.

armor_costume.head: No headgear, but she wears two large red ribbons in her hair. Sometimes a small tiara for formal occasions.

armor_costume.torso: Black Bulls robe over a form-fitting blue dress with white trim. The dress has a V-neck and is both elegant and practical for combat. The Black Bulls emblem is on the back of her robe.

armor_costume.arms: Long blue sleeves with white cuffs. She wears white gloves.

armor_costume.legs: The dress extends to just above her knees, with white tights underneath and blue heeled boots.

armor_costume.accessories: Her grimoire—a blue book with a clover. She also carries a small pouch with cosmetics and a hand mirror. She treasures a small charm Asta gave her (unknowingly).

abilities.name: Water Magic
abilities.short_description: Noelle controls water with incredible precision, creating powerful aquatic attacks.
abilities.full_description: Noelle's magic attribute is water, a rare and versatile element. Initially unable to control it due to her royal family's curse, she gradually masters it through training and emotional growth. Her spells range from defensive barriers (Sea God's Shield) to offensive blasts (Sea Dragon's Roar). She can also create water dragons that pursue enemies and even manipulate the moisture in the air.

abilities.name: Valkyrie Armor
abilities.short_description: Noelle encases herself in a suit of water armor, vastly increasing her combat capabilities.
abilities.full_description: One of Noelle's most advanced techniques, she creates a suit of armor made of highly pressurized water. The armor enhances her physical strength, speed, and defense, allowing her to fight in close combat. The water armor can also shapeshift, creating extra limbs or weapons. It represents her mastery over her magic and her determination to protect her friends.

abilities.name: Sea Dragon's Cradle
abilities.short_description: Noelle creates a massive water dragon that surrounds and protects allies while attacking enemies.
abilities.full_description: A defensive and offensive spell that manifests a gigantic water dragon coiled around Noelle and her allies. The dragon can strike at enemies with its massive body while providing a protective barrier. It's a testament to her growth as a mage and her desire to protect those she loves.

characters.name: Yami Sukehiro
alias: The Captain of the Black Bulls
The One Who Exceeds His Limits
title: Captain of the Black Bulls
Wizard Rank: First Class Senior Magic Knight
Master of Dark Magic
The One Who Came from the Land of the Sun

head.eyes: Sharp, observant dark brown eyes that miss nothing. They often squint with amusement or narrow with deadly intent. His gaze can intimidate even his own squad members.
head.nose: Straight, well-defined nose with a slight bump from past fights.
head.ears: Normal human ears, pierced with two small silver earrings in each.
head.extra_facial_features: Jet-black hair styled in a pompadour, held in place with product (or sheer will). He has a strong, rugged face with a perpetual five o'clock shadow. A cigarette dangles from his mouth almost constantly. His expression is usually a lazy smirk or a dangerous scowl.

body.chest: Tall and powerfully built (46 inches) with a lean, muscular physique honed through years of combat. His chest is broad and defined, visible through his open shirt.
body.arms: Well-defined arms (17 inches) with visible veins and muscles. His hands are large and strong, capable of drawing his katana in an instant.

lower_body.legs: Long, powerful legs (25 inches) that allow him to move with surprising speed. He can close distances in an instant.

armor_costume.head: No headgear, his pompadour is his crown. Sometimes wears sunglasses.

armor_costume.torso: A black, open vest over a bare chest, showing his muscular torso. He wears a black cape with the Black Bulls emblem on the back. Sometimes he adds a haori-like coat. His outfit is deliberately casual and intimidating.

armor_costume.arms: Bare arms, showing his muscles. He wears black fingerless gloves.

armor_costume.legs: Black pants with a white sash belt, tucked into black combat boots.

armor_costume.accessories: His katana, which he uses to channel his Dark Magic. He always carries cigarettes and a lighter. A small sake flask is often on his person.

abilities.name: Dark Magic
abilities.short_description: Yami manipulates darkness itself, creating powerful attacks that can cut through anything.
abilities.full_description: Dark Magic is an extremely rare and powerful attribute. Yami can create blades of darkness (Dark Cloaked Dimension Slash), summon beasts of shadow, and even create a field of absolute darkness that nullifies other magic. His darkness can also absorb and suppress magical attacks. His ultimate technique is the Dimension Slash, which cuts through space itself.

abilities.name: Dimension Slash
abilities.short_description: Yami's signature technique, a sword strike imbued with Dark Magic that cuts through dimensions.
abilities.full_description: By channeling his Dark Magic into his katana, Yami can slash through space itself, creating a rift that can cut anything regardless of distance or magical defenses. The attack is so fast and precise that it can even sever dimensions. He used this technique to defeat the elf-possessed Licht and later against devils.

abilities.name: Black Hole
abilities.short_description: Yami creates a sphere of concentrated darkness that absorbs all light and magic, sucking everything into it.
abilities.full_description: Yami manifests a small, intensely dark sphere that acts like a miniature black hole. It pulls in all surrounding matter and magic, effectively neutralizing attacks and trapping enemies. The Black Hole is incredibly dangerous and requires precise control to avoid harming allies.

characters.name: Finral Roulacase
title: Black Bull Member
Former Noble of House Roulacase
Master of Spatial Magic
The One Who Opens the Way

head.eyes: Large, light brown eyes that often show nervousness or flirtatious charm. They can become focused and determined when protecting his comrades.
head.ears: Normal human ears, with a small silver earring in one ear.
head.extra_facial_features: Short, messy dark green hair with a few strands hanging over his forehead. He has a handsome, boyish face with a perpetual nervous smile or a charming grin. A small scar on his chin.

body.chest: Lean and athletic (38 inches) with a slim build. Not muscular, but fit enough for a support mage.
body.arms: Slender arms (13 inches) with nimble hands for drawing magical circles.

lower_body.legs: Average legs (21 inches), not particularly strong. He relies on portals for movement.

armor_costume.head: No headgear. His hair is styled with a small amount of product.

armor_costume.torso: Black Bulls robe over a light green vest and white button-up shirt. He wears a black bow tie, a signature of his playboy style. The outfit is neat and fashionable.

armor_costume.arms: His arms are covered by the shirt sleeves. He wears simple black gloves.

armor_costume.legs: Black pants and brown dress shoes. A belt with a silver buckle.

armor_costume.accessories: His grimoire, which is green. He also carries a small flask of cologne and a comb. He often has a pocket square.

abilities.name: Spatial Magic
abilities.short_description: Finral creates portals that allow instantaneous travel and can redirect attacks.
abilities.full_description: Finral's Spatial Magic allows him to open portals between any two locations he can see or sense. He can teleport himself and others, redirect enemy spells by opening portals in front of them, and create small portals for tactical advantages. His magic is purely supportive—he cannot create offensive spatial attacks like his brother Langris. His portals are crucial for the Black Bulls' strategies.

abilities.name: Fallen Angel Gate
abilities.short_description: Finral creates a massive portal that can teleport entire groups or large spells.
abilities.full_description: An advanced version of his portals, Fallen Angel Gate is a large, ornate gateway that can teleport multiple people or even giant magical attacks. It requires significant mana and concentration, but its utility is immense. He used it to teleport the Black Bulls during the elf invasion and to redirect powerful enemy spells.

abilities.name: Spatial Link
abilities.short_description: Finral can sense spatial coordinates and track people through his portals.
abilities.full_description: Finral has a natural ability to sense locations and people through space. He can track allies by their mana signatures and open portals directly to them, even across long distances. This makes him an exceptional scout and support.

head.eyes: Large, sleepy violet eyes that often look half-closed, as if she's permanently tipsy. They sharpen with focus when using her magic or protecting her family.
head.nose: Small and delicate, often red from drinking.
head.ears: Small, with long, dangling earrings—purple tassels or beads.
head.extra_facial_features: Long, wavy purple hair that reaches her waist, often messy and unkempt. She has a beautiful, mature face with full lips and a lazy smile. A small beauty mark under her right eye. She always has a bottle of alcohol in hand or nearby.

body.chest: Voluptuous and curvy (39 inches) with an hourglass figure. Her body is soft but not weak—she's surprisingly resilient.
body.arms: Slender arms (14 inches) with dexterous fingers perfect for weaving threads.

lower_body.legs: Long, shapely legs (23 inches) that she often shows off in her witch's attire.

armor_costume.head: No headgear, but she sometimes wears a small witch's hat in her Witch's Forest days. Now, she wears her hair loose.

armor_costume.torso: A revealing witch's outfit: a low-cut purple dress with a corset, showing significant cleavage. Over it, she wears the Black Bulls robe, often open. The dress has lace and spiderweb patterns.

armor_costume.arms: Long purple gloves that reach her elbows, with lace trim. Her arms are otherwise bare.

armor_costume.legs: The dress is short, revealing her legs, with thigh-high purple stockings and heeled boots.

armor_costume.accessories: Her constant companion: a bottle of wine or liquor in a gourd. She also has a small pouch with herbs. Her grimoire is purple.

abilities.name: Thread Magic
abilities.short_description: Vanessa creates and manipulates magical threads for various purposes, from binding enemies to fortune-telling.
abilities.full_description: Vanessa's Thread Magic allows her to create nearly invisible threads that can bind opponents, create protective webs, or even stitch wounds. Her threads are incredibly strong and flexible. She can also use them for reconnaissance, sensing vibrations through the threads.

abilities.name: Roulette of Fate
abilities.short_description: Vanessa's ultimate spell, which allows her to rewrite fate itself to protect those she cares about.
abilities.full_description: Using her Witch of Fate powers, Vanessa can spin a magical roulette that alters destiny. When activated, it ensures that any harm coming to her chosen target (usually her Black Bulls family) is negated, redirecting attacks and ensuring survival. The spell is incredibly taxing and requires immense emotional investment, but it has saved the Black Bulls countless times. It represents her love for her found family.

abilities.name: Binding Threads
abilities.short_description: Vanessa entangles enemies in unbreakable threads, immobilizing them.
abilities.full_description: A basic but effective technique, Vanessa weaves threads around opponents, binding their limbs and preventing movement. The threads are magical and can't be broken by physical strength alone. She can also create thread walls for defense.

characters.name: Luck Voltia
title: Black Bull Member
Master of Lightning Magic
The One Who Finds Joy in Combat
The Happiest Warrior

head.eyes: Large, bright green eyes that sparkle with childlike excitement and bloodlust. They widen with joy when he finds a strong opponent, narrowing with focus in battle.
head.nose: Small and rounded, often with a grin.
head.ears: Normal human ears, slightly pointed. He has a small scar on one ear from a fight.
head.extra_facial_features: Short, spiky yellow hair that stands on end, resembling lightning. He has a youthful, cheerful face with a perpetual grin. His expression is almost always happy, even when he's about to kill someone.

body.chest: Small and lean (36 inches) with a wiry, athletic build. Not muscular, but incredibly fast.
body.arms: Thin arms (12 inches) with surprising speed. His hands are small but dexterous.

lower_body.legs: Long, thin legs (22 inches) built for speed. He can move at lightning velocity.

armor_costume.head: No headgear. His spiky hair is his trademark.

armor_costume.torso: Black Bulls robe over a yellow vest with black stripes. Underneath, a black long-sleeved shirt. The outfit is practical and allows free movement.

armor_costume.arms: His arms are covered by the shirt sleeves. He wears yellow gloves with black stripes.

armor_costume.legs: Black pants with yellow stripes down the sides, tucked into yellow boots.

armor_costume.accessories: His grimoire, which is yellow. He carries no other accessories—he needs only a good fight.

abilities.name: Lightning Magic
abilities.short_description: Luck controls lightning, using it for devastating attacks and incredible speed.
abilities.full_description: Luck's Lightning Magic allows him to generate and manipulate electricity. He can fire lightning bolts (Thunderbolt), enhance his speed to near-instantaneous levels, and electrify his body to damage anyone who touches him. His fighting style is aggressive and relentless.

abilities.name: Lightning God Gloves
abilities.short_description: Luck creates gauntlets of lightning that amplify his punching power.
abilities.full_description: By concentrating lightning around his fists, Luck forms powerful gauntlets that increase the destructive force of his punches. Each punch carries a massive electrical discharge, stunning and damaging opponents. This technique allows him to fight in close quarters with devastating effect.

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.short_description: Luck releases all his lightning in a massive explosion around himself.
abilities.full_description: A desperation move, Luck discharges all his stored electrical energy in a massive radial blast. The explosion damages everything nearby and leaves him temporarily drained, but it's an effective last resort against multiple enemies.

characters.name: Magna Swing
alias: The One Who Never Backs Down
title: Black Bull Member
Master of Fire Magic
First Magic Knight from the Forsaken Realm
The One Who Fights for the Underdog

head.eyes: Intense, fiery orange eyes that blaze with passion and determination. They show his hot-blooded nature and never-say-die attitude.
head.nose: Average nose, often with a bandage or scar.
head.ears: Normal human ears, pierced with multiple small studs.
head.extra_facial_features: Short, spiky orange hair styled in a rebellious punk manner. He has a strong, rough face with a perpetual scowl or battle grin. A scar runs through his left eyebrow. He often has a bandage on his cheek or nose from recent fights.

body.chest: Athletic and muscular (40 inches) with a lean, fighter's build. His chest shows defined muscles from training.
body.arms: Well-defined arms (15 inches) with visible muscle. His hands are calloused from gripping his baseball bat-like focus.

lower_body.legs: Powerful legs (22 inches) built for quick movement and agile combat.

armor_costume.head: No headgear, his spiky hair is his signature. Sometimes wears a bandana.

armor_costume.torso: Black Bulls robe over a black tank top with a flame design. He often wears the robe open, showing his chest. A chain wallet hangs from his belt.

armor_costume.arms: Bare arms, showing his muscles and tattoos (flame designs on his shoulders). He wears black fingerless gloves.

armor_costume.legs: Black pants with chains, tucked into heavy combat boots.

armor_costume.accessories: His magical focus: a wooden baseball bat that he uses to channel his fire magic. He also carries a pack of cigarettes and a lighter.

abilities.name: Fire Magic
abilities.short_description: Magna creates and controls fire, using it for offensive attacks and area denial.
abilities.full_description: Magna's Fire Magic allows him to generate flames from his body and weapon. His signature spell is Fireball, a concentrated sphere of flame he can throw at enemies. He can also create walls of fire, explosive bursts, and even coat his bat in flames for melee combat.

abilities.name: Fireball Bat Swing
abilities.short_description: Magna charges his bat with fire and swings it to launch a massive fireball.
abilities.full_description: By focusing his mana into his bat, Magna can hit flames like a baseball, sending them flying at enemies with incredible speed and force. The technique is unpredictable in trajectory and can be angled for trick shots.

abilities.name: Flame Road
abilities.short_description: Magna creates a path of fire that he can ride like a skateboard, increasing his mobility.
abilities.full_description: A creative use of his magic, Magna generates a trail of fire beneath his feet that propels him forward at high speed. He can use it to chase enemies or escape danger, and it leaves a burning trail behind.

characters.name: Gauche Adlai
alias: The One Who Loves His Sister
title: Black Bull Member
Former Noble of House Adlai
Master of Mirror Magic
The One Who Sees His Sister in Everyone

head.eyes: Pale, unsettling grey eyes that often stare intensely, especially when talking about his sister. They can become sharp and focused in battle.
head.ears: Normal human ears, with a small earring.
head.extra_facial_features: Long, unkempt black hair that covers one eye. He has a pale, gaunt face with dark circles under his eyes, giving him a creepy appearance. A perpetual slight smile that seems unnerving.

body.chest: Lean and lanky (37 inches) with a thin build. Not muscular, but deceptively strong.
body.arms: Long, thin arms (14 inches) with nimble fingers for drawing magical symbols.

lower_body.legs: Long, thin legs (22 inches). He moves with an awkward gait.

armor_costume.head: No headgear, his hair covers his right eye.

armor_costume.torso: Black Bulls robe over a black vest and white shirt. He wears a red ascot or bow tie. His outfit is somewhat disheveled.

armor_costume.arms: Covered by the shirt sleeves. He wears black gloves.

armor_costume.legs: Black pants and worn boots.

armor_costume.accessories: His grimoire, which is grey. He always carries a small locket with a picture of his sister, Marie. He also has a collection of mirrors.

abilities.name: Mirror Magic
abilities.short_description: Gauche creates and manipulates mirrors for attack, defense, and duplication.
abilities.full_description: Gauche's Mirror Magic allows him to generate reflective surfaces anywhere. He can use mirrors to deflect spells, create barriers, and even teleport by stepping through them. His most powerful ability is creating mirror copies of himself or others, though the copies are imperfect.

abilities.name: Mirror Brigade
abilities.short_description: Gauche creates multiple copies of himself to overwhelm enemies with numbers.
abilities.full_description: By creating a series of mirrors, Gauche generates dozens of mirror copies of himself that can attack independently. The copies are fragile but numerous, making them excellent for swarm tactics. He can also use them for reconnaissance.

abilities.name: Reflect
abilities.short_description: Gauche uses mirrors to reflect enemy spells back at them.
abilities.full_description: A simple but effective defensive technique, Gauche positions mirrors to catch incoming magic and reflect it toward its caster or another target. The reflection maintains the spell's original power.

characters.name: Charmy Pappitson
title: Black Bull Member
Half-Dwarf, Half-Human
Master of Cotton Magic and Food Magic
The One Who Fights for Food

head.eyes: Large, round brown eyes that sparkle with joy when she sees food and narrow with suspicion when someone threatens her meals. In battle, they can become surprisingly sharp.
head.ears: Small, slightly pointed like a dwarf's, often hidden by her curly hair.
head.extra_facial_features: Short, curly brown hair with sheep-like horns on her head (a dwarf trait). She has a round, cherubic face with rosy cheeks. Her expression is usually a happy smile, especially while eating.

body.chest: Short and plump (38 inches) with a soft, round body. She is small but deceptively powerful.
body.arms: Short, pudgy arms (12 inches) with surprising strength when she's angry or hungry.

lower_body.legs: Short, stubby legs (18 inches) that carry her surprisingly fast when food is involved.

armor_costume.head: No headgear, but her sheep horns are natural.

armor_costume.torso: Black Bulls robe over a frilly pink and white dress with a sheep motif. She wears a large bib while eating.

armor_costume.arms: Puffy sleeves cover her arms. She wears small mittens.

armor_costume.legs: The dress covers her legs, with small boots peeking out.

armor_costume.accessories: Her most important accessory: a magic cooking set, including a frying pan and spatula that she uses as weapons. She also carries endless supplies of food in her magic pocket.

abilities.name: Cotton Magic
abilities.short_description: Charmy creates and controls cotton, using it for defense and utility.
abilities.full_description: Charmy's primary magic allows her to generate soft, fluffy cotton. She can create cotton shields that absorb impacts, cotton clouds to float on, and cotton ropes to bind enemies. It's a versatile, non-lethal magic.

abilities.name: Food Magic
abilities.short_description: Charmy's hidden dwarf magic allows her to create magical food that heals and empowers those who eat it.
abilities.full_description: When truly threatened or when food is involved, Charmy awakens her dwarf heritage and gains Food Magic. She can create magical dishes that restore health and mana, and even summon a giant sheep that fights for her. The sheep is incredibly powerful, capable of eating enemies and their magic.

abilities.name: Wolf Bite
abilities.short_description: Charmy's giant sheep opens its mouth and takes a massive bite out of enemies or their spells.
abilities.full_description: A combination of her Cotton and Food Magic, Charmy summons her sheep companion, which can take enormous bites out of anything—physical or magical. The bite is so powerful it can consume magic attacks and even devour portions of the battlefield.

characters.name: Gordon Agrippa
alias: The Ghost of the Black Bulls
The One Who Speaks in Whispers
title: Black Bull Member
Heir of House Agrippa
Master of Curse Magic
The One Who Curses in Silence

head.eyes: Large, hollow black eyes with no visible pupils, giving him a ghostly appearance. They rarely show emotion.
head.nose: Barely visible, just two small nostrils.
head.ears: Normal human ears, hidden by his long hair.
head.extra_facial_features: Long, straight black hair that covers most of his face, parted in the middle. He has extremely pale skin, almost white. His expression is perpetually blank or mildly worried. A small scar on his forehead.

body.chest: Thin and gaunt (35 inches) with a frail-looking build. He's not physically strong.
body.arms: Long, thin arms (13 inches) with skeletal hands perfect for intricate curse work.

lower_body.legs: Thin legs (20 inches) that move silently, like a ghost.

armor_costume.head: No headgear, his hair covers his face.

armor_costume.torso: Black Bulls robe over a dark purple, high-collared shirt with a spiderweb pattern. He wears the robe closed, hiding most of his body.

armor_costume.arms: Long sleeves cover his arms. He wears black gloves.

armor_costume.legs: Dark purple pants and black boots.

armor_costume.accessories: His grimoire, which is dark purple with a spider emblem. He carries a small pouch of herbs and vials for curses. He also has a pet spider that sits on his shoulder.

abilities.name: Curse Magic
abilities.short_description: Gordon specializes in curses that afflict enemies with various maladies and misfortunes.
abilities.full_description: Gordon's Curse Magic allows him to place debilitating curses on opponents. These curses can cause paralysis, weakness, confusion, or even slow death. He can also remove curses and use them defensively. His magic is subtle but extremely dangerous.

abilities.name: Curse Transfer
abilities.short_description: Gordon can transfer curses from one target to another, including himself.
abilities.full_description: A specialized technique, Gordon can move active curses between people. This allows him to take curses off allies and place them onto enemies or even absorb them himself temporarily. It requires precise control.

abilities.name: Miasma
abilities.short_description: Gordon releases a cloud of cursed mist that weakens and sickens all who enter it.
abilities.full_description: Gordon creates a dense purple fog infused with multiple curses. Anyone breathing the mist suffers from progressive weakness, confusion, and malaise. The fog also obscures vision and masks his movements.

characters.name: Grey
alias: The Girl Who Hides Her Face
The One Who Wants to Be Someone Else
title: Black Bull Member
Master of Transformation Magic
The One Who Changes Form
The Timid Soul

head.eyes: Large, fearful grey eyes that always look like they're about to cry. They hide behind her hood, rarely making direct contact.
head.ears: Normal human ears, hidden by her hair and hood.
head.extra_facial_features: Her true face is rarely seen, as she constantly uses transformation magic. In her true form, she has short, messy grey hair and a plain, timid face covered in freckles. She usually appears as a nondescript person or even objects to avoid attention.

body.chest: In her true form, she is thin and petite (34 inches). She can transform into any body she desires.
body.arms: Thin arms (11 inches) that she keeps hidden.

lower_body.legs: Thin legs (19 inches) that she uses to run and hide.

armor_costume.head: A large hood that covers most of her face, leaving only her fearful eyes visible.

armor_costume.torso: Black Bulls robe worn over a plain, oversized grey shirt and pants that hide her figure.

armor_costume.arms: Long sleeves cover her arms completely. She keeps her hands tucked inside.

armor_costume.legs: Baggy pants and simple shoes.

armor_costume.accessories: Her grimoire, which is grey. She carries no other accessories—she prefers to be invisible.

abilities.name: Transformation Magic
abilities.short_description: Grey can transform herself and others into different forms, objects, or even creatures.
abilities.full_description: Grey's magic allows her to alter the appearance and properties of people and objects. She can turn herself into anyone, transform enemies into harmless animals, or change rocks into weapons. The transformations are temporary but can be extremely useful in combat and infiltration.

abilities.name: Perfect Copy
abilities.short_description: Grey can perfectly replicate the appearance and voice of anyone she has seen.
abilities.full_description: By studying a person's features and mannerisms, Grey can transform into a flawless copy of them, including their voice and clothing. This makes her an exceptional spy and infiltrator.

abilities.name: Mass Transformation
abilities.short_description: Grey can transform multiple targets at once, though it requires immense concentration.
abilities.full_description: With enough focus, Grey can alter the forms of entire groups. She once transformed several Black Bulls members into different people to escape pursuit. The spell is draining but highly effective.

characters.name: Henry Legolant
alias: The One Who Built the Base
title: Black Bull Member
Original Owner of the Black Bulls Base
Master of Recombination Magic
The One Who Lives in the Walls

head.eyes: Large, sunken dark eyes with heavy bags, showing his constant exhaustion from his curse. They light up with joy when his friends visit.
head.ears: Normal human ears, hidden by his wild hair.
head.extra_facial_features: Wild, unkempt dark hair that sticks out in all directions. His skin is pale and sickly due to his life-draining curse. He has a gaunt, hollow-cheeked face with a perpetual weak smile.

body.chest: Extremely thin and frail (34 inches) from his curse, which constantly drains his life force. He is bedridden most of the time.
body.arms: Stick-thin arms (10 inches) with visible veins.

lower_body.legs: Similarly thin legs (18 inches) that can barely support him.

armor_costume.head: No headgear, his wild hair is his signature.

armor_costume.torso: He wears simple, loose black robes that hang off his thin frame. The Black Bulls emblem is somewhere on his clothing.

armor_costume.arms: Long sleeves cover his thin arms.

armor_costume.legs: Loose pants and soft slippers.

armor_costume.accessories: His grimoire, which is dark and tattered. He also has various pipes and mechanisms integrated into the Black Bulls base, which he controls.

abilities.name: Recombination Magic
abilities.short_description: Henry can rearrange and reconstruct physical objects, including the Black Bulls base itself.
abilities.full_description: Henry's unique magic allows him to disassemble and reassemble inanimate objects at will. He used this power to build the Black Bulls' headquarters, and he can reshape rooms, create traps, and repair damage instantly. The entire base is an extension of his magic.

abilities.name: Life Drain Curse
abilities.short_description: Henry is afflicted with a curse that drains his life force constantly, but it also gives him the power to absorb mana from others.
abilities.full_description: Henry's curse slowly consumes his life energy, but it allows him to passively absorb ambient mana from those around him. This mana fuels his Recombination Magic. When other Black Bulls are in the base, their residual mana keeps him alive and powers his abilities.

abilities.name: Base Control
abilities.short_description: Henry can manipulate every part of the Black Bulls headquarters, using it as a weapon or defense.
abilities.full_description: By focusing his magic, Henry can control the entire building. Walls shift, floors open, and rooms reconfigure themselves. He can create defensive barriers, launch parts of the building as projectiles, and protect his friends within.

characters.name: Zora Ideale
alias: The One Who Hates Magic Knights
title: Black Bull Member
Son of Zara Ideale (First Commoner Magic Knight)
Master of Ash Magic and Trap Magic
The One Who Fights Dirty

head.eyes: Sharp, cynical dark eyes that always seem to be judging everyone. They narrow with suspicion and widen with sarcastic amusement.
head.nose: Straight, slightly crooked from a past fight.
head.ears: Normal human ears, with multiple piercings.
head.extra_facial_features: Messy, dark purple hair that sticks up in spikes. He has a perpetual scowl or smirk on his face. A small scar on his lip. He often has a cigarette dangling from his mouth.

body.chest: Lean and athletic (40 inches) with a wiry, agile build. Not bulky, but strong enough for combat.
body.arms: Well-defined arms (15 inches) with visible muscle. His hands are quick and precise for setting traps.

lower_body.legs: Long, agile legs (23 inches) built for quick movement and acrobatics.

armor_costume.head: A black hood that he often wears up, covering most of his face except his eyes and cigarette.

armor_costume.torso: Black Bulls robe over a dark, tattered cloak. Underneath, he wears a simple black shirt and vest. His outfit is designed to blend in with shadows.

armor_costume.arms: His arms are covered by the cloak's sleeves. He wears black gloves.

armor_costume.legs: Dark pants with multiple pockets for trap components, tucked into combat boots.

armor_costume.accessories: His grimoire, which is dark grey. He carries countless trap materials: magical glyphs, wires, smoke pellets, and a cigarette case. He also has a small pouch with his father's medal.

abilities.name: Ash Magic
abilities.short_description: Zora creates and controls ash, using it to obscure vision and create smokescreens.
abilities.full_description: Zora's natural magic allows him to generate clouds of ash that block vision and sensor abilities. He can also use ash to create decoys or enhance his traps. It's a simple but effective utility magic.

abilities.name: Trap Magic
abilities.short_description: Zora sets magical traps that reflect or amplify enemy spells back at them.
abilities.full_description: Zora's true genius lies in his trap creation. He sets up magical circles that, when triggered, redirect enemy magic back at the caster with increased power. He can also create traps that amplify friendly spells or create barriers. His traps are invisible and require enemies to trigger them.

abilities.name: Counterfeit Magic
abilities.short_description: Zora copies the magic of his enemies and turns it against them.
abilities.full_description: By analyzing an enemy's spell, Zora can create a trap that replicates the magic and fires it back. He used this to great effect against the elves, turning their own attacks against them. It requires quick thinking and deep understanding of magic.

characters.name: Secre Swallowtail
title: Black Bull Member
Former Royal Mage of the Clover Kingdom
Master of Sealing Magic
The One Who Sealed the Demons

head.eyes: Large, expressive blue eyes that hold centuries of sadness and wisdom. They can shift from timid to fiercely determined.
head.ears: Small, hidden by her hair. In her bird form, she has feathers.
head.extra_facial_features: Long, silver-blue hair that reaches her waist, often tied in two side buns with small braids. She has a beautiful, youthful face with fair skin. Her expression is usually calm or slightly melancholic.

body.chest: Slender and petite (35 inches) with a small, delicate frame.
body.arms: Thin arms (12 inches) with nimble fingers for drawing sealing circles.

lower_body.legs: Slim legs (20 inches) that she uses to move gracefully.

armor_costume.head: No headgear. She sometimes wears a small bow in her hair.

armor_costume.torso: A white and blue robe with feather patterns, reminiscent of her bird form. Over it, she wears the Black Bulls robe. Her outfit is elegant and priestess-like.

armor_costume.arms: Long white sleeves cover her arms. She wears white gloves.

armor_costume.legs: A long white skirt with blue trim, and simple white shoes.

armor_costume.accessories: Her grimoire, which is blue with a bird emblem. She also carries a small pouch with sealing tags and her transformation item (the item that allows her to turn into a bird).

abilities.name: Sealing Magic
abilities.short_description: Secre can seal anything—magic, objects, even people—into containers or tags.
abilities.full_description: Secre's sealing magic allows her to contain and suppress magical entities. She sealed the demons for centuries, and can seal spells, curses, or even temporarily imprison enemies. Her seals are incredibly powerful and difficult to break.

abilities.name: Forbidden Sealing Magic: Eternal Prison
abilities.short_description: Secre's ultimate sealing spell, capable of trapping even demons for eternity.
abilities.full_description: A powerful sealing spell that creates an inescapable prison for a target. It requires immense mana and preparation, but can contain beings of god-like power. She used this to seal the demons and later to help contain Zagred.

abilities.name: Transformation
abilities.short_description: Secre can transform into a small, black and blue bird (Nero) at will.
abilities.full_description: Due to her long life and the nature of her magic, Secre gained the ability to transform into a bird. In this form, she is small and inconspicuous, perfect for spying and moving unnoticed. She retains her intelligence and can speak.

characters.name: Mereoleona Vermillion
alias: The Strongest Woman in the Clover Kingdom
title: Acting Captain of the Crimson Lions
First Daughter of House Vermillion
Master of Fire Magic
The One Who Tames Beasts

head.eyes: Fierce, golden eyes that blaze with untamed power and joy in battle. They are the eyes of a predator, always seeking a worthy opponent.
head.nose: Straight and strong, fitting her commanding presence.
head.ears: Normal human ears, with small gold earrings.
head.extra_facial_features: Wild, shoulder-length blonde hair with natural streaks of red, like flames. She has a strong, beautiful face with sharp cheekbones and a perpetual confident smirk. A small scar above her eyebrow. Her expression is always fierce and excited.

body.chest: Athletic and powerfully built (41 inches) with a muscular, toned physique. Her body is honed through constant combat, with defined abs and strong shoulders.
body.arms: Strong, muscular arms (16 inches) with visible veins. Her hands are calloused and ready for battle.

lower_body.legs: Long, powerful legs (24 inches) that can propel her at incredible speeds. She moves like a lioness.

armor_costume.head: No headgear. Her wild hair is her mane.

armor_costume.torso: A revealing outfit befitting her wild nature: a fur-lined bikini top (often a leopard or lion pattern) showing her midriff. Over it, she wears a short cape or the Crimson Lions robe. Her outfit is practical for combat and shows her muscular build.

armor_costume.arms: Bare arms, showing her muscles. She wears leather bracers on her forearms.

armor_costume.legs: Tight leather pants tucked into fur-lined boots. A belt with a lion-head buckle.

armor_costume.accessories: Her grimoire, which is crimson. She carries no unnecessary accessories—only her fists and her magic.

abilities.name: Fire Magic
abilities.short_description: Mereoleona commands fire with unparalleled ferocity, using it for devastating offense and defense.
abilities.full_description: Mereoleona's Fire Magic is among the most powerful in the Clover Kingdom. She can create massive fireballs (Calidus Brachium), flaming lions that hunt enemies, and walls of fire that incinerate everything. Her flames are so hot they can melt steel and burn through magical defenses.

abilities.name: Calidus Brachium
abilities.short_description: Mereoleona's signature technique, creating a massive arm of fire to strike enemies.
abilities.full_description: She manifests a giant, flaming arm that she can control like her own. The arm can punch, grab, and crush opponents with incredible force. It's both a long-range and close-combat technique.

abilities.name: Lion's Roar
abilities.short_description: Mereoleona releases a massive wave of fire and sound that incinerates everything in front of her.
abilities.full_description: By channeling her mana into a roar, Mereoleona creates a devastating cone of fire that expands rapidly. The attack is both physical and magical, overwhelming enemies with sheer power.

head.eyes: Noble, intense red eyes that burn with honor and determination. They reflect his leadership and unwavering sense of justice.
head.nose: Straight, strong nose befitting a royal.
head.ears: Normal human ears, with a small gold earring.
head.extra_facial_features: Long, flowing crimson hair tied in a ponytail with a gold clasp. He has a handsome, chiseled face with a strong jawline. His expression is usually serious and commanding, but can soften with kindness. A small scar on his left cheek from battle.

body.chest: Tall and powerfully built (44 inches) with a muscular, athletic frame. His chest is broad and strong, the body of a warrior captain.
body.arms: Well-defined arms (17 inches) with visible muscle. His hands are large and capable.

lower_body.legs: Long, powerful legs (24 inches) that carry him with the grace of a lion.

armor_costume.head: No headgear, his ponytail is his crown. Sometimes wears a golden circlet for formal events.

armor_costume.torso: Crimson Lions captain's robe—a long red coat with gold trim and the lion emblem. Underneath, a white shirt with a high collar and a red cravat. The outfit is regal and immaculate.

armor_costume.arms: His arms are covered by the coat's sleeves. He wears white gloves.

armor_costume.legs: White pants with red stripes, tucked into polished brown boots.

armor_costume.accessories: His grimoire, which is crimson with a lion emblem. After receiving Salamander, he often has the fire spirit nearby. He also carries a ceremonial sword.

abilities.name: Fire Magic
abilities.short_description: Fuegoleon commands fire with precision and power, using both offensive and defensive spells.
abilities.full_description: As a Vermillion, Fuegoleon's Fire Magic is extremely powerful. He can create massive fireballs, flaming lions, and defensive walls of fire. His spells are controlled and strategic, reflecting his disciplined mind.

abilities.name: Salamander
abilities.short_description: Fuegoleon is the host of the fire spirit Salamander, granting him immense power and control over flames.
abilities.full_description: After being chosen by Salamander, Fuegoleon's fire magic reached new heights. Salamander can act independently, breathing massive flames and protecting its host. Together, they can create flames that burn even magic itself.

abilities.name: Lion's Roar
abilities.short_description: Fuegoleon unleashes a massive column of fire that rises from the ground, incinerating everything above.
abilities.full_description: A powerful area-of-effect spell, Fuegoleon summons a pillar of flame that erupts from below his target. The attack is difficult to dodge and deals massive damage. He can also direct multiple pillars.

characters.name: Leopold Vermillion
alias: The One Who Admires His Siblings
title: Crimson Lion Member
Third Son of House Vermillion
Fire Magic User
The One Striving to Surpass His Elders

head.eyes: Bright, eager red eyes that shine with youthful enthusiasm and a desire to prove himself.
head.ears: Normal human ears.
head.extra_facial_features: Short, spiky crimson hair similar to his siblings but less styled. He has a young, boyish face with freckles across his nose. His expression is usually determined or excited.

body.chest: Lean and developing (38 inches) as he's still growing. He has the build of an athletic teenager.
body.arms: Slender arms (13 inches) with some muscle from training.

lower_body.legs: Average legs (21 inches), still growing into his adult height.

armor_costume.head: No headgear. His hair is messy and boyish.

armor_costume.torso: Crimson Lions uniform: a red jacket with gold trim over a white shirt. The jacket is slightly too big for him, showing he's still growing.

armor_costume.arms: Covered by the jacket sleeves. He wears simple gloves.

armor_costume.legs: Red pants and brown boots.

armor_costume.accessories: His grimoire, which is red. He carries no other accessories, focusing on training.

abilities.name: Fire Magic
abilities.short_description: Leopold uses fire magic, though not as powerful as his siblings, he shows great potential.
abilities.full_description: Leopold's fire magic is still developing. He can create fireballs and basic flame attacks. He is eager to learn and improve, constantly training to catch up to his brother and sister.

abilities.name: Flame Bomb
abilities.short_description: Leopold creates a concentrated fireball that explodes on impact.
abilities.full_description: His signature technique, a powerful fireball that he can throw with accuracy. It's a standard but effective spell.

abilities.name: Burning Passion
abilities.short_description: Leopold's determination and enthusiasm fuel his growth, allowing him to push beyond his limits.
abilities.full_description: Leopold's greatest asset is his burning desire to become stronger. This passion drives him to train harder and never give up, earning him the respect of his squad.

characters.name: Julius Novachrono
title: 28th Wizard King of the Clover Kingdom
Master of Time Magic
The Greatest Mage of the Era
The One Who Protects the Future

head.eyes: Wise, kind dark eyes that twinkle with curiosity and a childlike wonder. They can become intensely focused when using his time magic.
head.ears: Normal human ears, with a small stud earring.
head.extra_facial_features: Short, neat black hair with a few white streaks at the temples. He has a friendly, approachable face with a perpetual smile. His expression is usually cheerful and curious, like a child exploring the world.

body.chest: Average build (40 inches) with no particular muscle definition. He relies on magic, not physical strength.
body.arms: Average arms (14 inches) with steady hands for casting spells.

lower_body.legs: Average legs (22 inches). He moves with a leisurely gait.

armor_costume.head: No headgear, his neat hair is his signature. Sometimes wears a small crown-like ornament for ceremonies.

armor_costume.torso: Wizard King robes—a magnificent white and gold coat with a high collar and the Clover Kingdom's emblem. Underneath, a white shirt and black pants. The robes are formal and regal, but he often wears them casually.

armor_costume.arms: Covered by the robe's sleeves. He wears white gloves.

armor_costume.legs: Black pants and polished black shoes.

armor_costume.accessories: His grimoire, which is gold with a clock emblem. He also carries a pocket watch, which is both a fashion accessory and a focus for his time magic.

abilities.name: Time Magic
abilities.short_description: Julius controls time itself, able to accelerate, decelerate, stop, and even reverse time.
abilities.full_description: As the only known user of Time Magic, Julius possesses the most powerful and dangerous magic attribute. He can slow enemies to a crawl, accelerate his own movements, stop time momentarily, and even reverse time by several seconds. His ultimate technique allows him to steal years from his enemies' lifespans. However, using time magic drains his own lifespan, which is why he ages visibly after major battles.

abilities.name: Chronostasis
abilities.short_description: Julius freezes time for a brief period, allowing him to reposition or attack.
abilities.full_description: By focusing his mana, Julius can stop time in a localized area for a few seconds. During this period, only he can move. It's an incredibly powerful ability that gives him an insurmountable advantage in combat.

abilities.name: Age Acceleration
abilities.short_description: Julius accelerates the time of his enemies, rapidly aging them and weakening their bodies.
abilities.full_description: A terrifying technique, Julius can target an opponent and accelerate their personal time, causing them to age rapidly. This drains their stamina and can eventually lead to death from old age. He used this against Patolli, though it cost him dearly.

characters.name: William Vangeance
alias: The Captain of the Golden Dawn
title: Captain of the Golden Dawn
Master of World Tree Magic
Vessel of the Elf Patolli
The One Who Bears Two Souls

head.eyes: Calm, gentle grey eyes that hide deep pain and conflict. They show kindness and a desire for peace.
head.nose: Straight, well-defined nose, partially hidden by his mask.
head.ears: Slightly pointed, hinting at his elf heritage, hidden by his hair.
head.extra_facial_features: He wears a distinctive white mask that covers the upper left half of his face, hiding severe burn scars from childhood. His visible skin is fair. He has silver-white hair, neatly styled. His expression is usually serene and kind.

body.chest: Tall and lean (42 inches) with an elegant, refined build. Not muscular, but fit.
body.arms: Long, slender arms (15 inches) with graceful hands.

lower_body.legs: Long legs (23 inches) that carry him with quiet dignity.

armor_costume.head: His signature white mask, which he never removes in public. It covers his left eye and surrounding scars.

armor_costume.torso: Golden Dawn captain's robe—a long white coat with gold trim and the sun emblem. Underneath, a white high-collared shirt and gold vest. The outfit is pristine and elegant.

armor_costume.arms: Covered by the robe's sleeves. He wears white gloves.

armor_costume.legs: White pants and white boots.

armor_costume.accessories: His grimoire, which is gold with a tree emblem. He carries no other visible accessories.

abilities.name: World Tree Magic
abilities.short_description: William creates and controls massive trees that can be used for attack, defense, and support.
abilities.full_description: William's World Tree Magic allows him to summon giant trees from the ground. These trees can create barriers, launch wooden projectiles, and even create healing fruits. The magic is versatile and powerful, representing life and growth.

abilities.name: Yggdrasil
abilities.short_description: William's ultimate spell, summoning a colossal world tree that connects the heavens and earth.
abilities.full_description: By pouring immense mana into his magic, William can summon Yggdrasil, a massive tree that reaches the sky. The tree can be used as a fortress, a weapon, or a conduit for healing magic. It's a spell of legendary proportions.

abilities.name: Healing Fruit
abilities.short_description: William grows fruits on his trees that heal wounds and restore mana when consumed.
abilities.full_description: A supportive aspect of his magic, William can create magical fruits that have powerful healing properties. These fruits can cure injuries and replenish magical energy, making him an invaluable support in large-scale battles.

characters.name: Patolli
title: Leader of the Eye of the Midnight Sun
Elf Reincarnated in Human Body
Master of Light Magic
The One Who Seeks Vengeance

head.eyes: Fierce, golden eyes that burn with hatred and righteous fury. They soften only when thinking of his fellow elves.
head.ears: Long, pointed elf ears, clearly visible.
head.extra_facial_features: Long, platinum blonde hair tied in a high ponytail. He has an angular, beautiful face with sharp features. His expression is usually one of cold determination or rage. He has no visible scars.

body.chest: Lean and athletic (41 inches) with a lithe, agile build typical of elves.
body.arms: Slender but muscular arms (15 inches) with nimble fingers.

lower_body.legs: Long, agile legs (23 inches) that allow him to move with supernatural grace.

armor_costume.head: No headgear. His long hair is his most distinctive feature.

armor_costume.torso: Eye of the Midnight Sun robes—a long, dark purple coat with a high collar and the eye emblem. Underneath, a black shirt with silver trim. The outfit is elegant and sinister.

armor_costume.arms: Covered by the robe's sleeves. He wears black gloves.

armor_costume.legs: Black pants and black boots with silver buckles.

armor_costume.accessories: His grimoire, which is dark with a light emblem. He carries a sword (a magic focus) at his side.

abilities.name: Light Magic
abilities.short_description: Patolli controls light, using it for blinding attacks, light-speed movement, and devastating beams.
abilities.full_description: Light Magic grants Patolli incredible speed and power. He can move at the speed of light, create blinding flashes, and fire concentrated light beams (Light Blades) that can cut through anything. His magic is nearly impossible to dodge and overwhelming in offense.

abilities.name: Judgment Light
abilities.short_description: Patolli summons a massive pillar of light from the sky, incinerating everything in its path.
abilities.full_description: His ultimate offensive spell, a colossal beam of light that descends from above, vaporizing anything it touches. The attack is so powerful it can destroy entire city blocks and is nearly impossible to block.

abilities.name: Photon Swords
abilities.short_description: Patolli creates multiple blades of light that he can control telekinetically.
abilities.full_description: He manifests dozens of floating light swords that he can direct to attack from all angles. The swords are fast, sharp, and can overwhelm any defense.

head.eyes: Piercing, intelligent golden eyes that hold ancient wisdom and deep sorrow. They reflect his tragic past and his love for his people.
head.ears: Long, pointed elf ears.
head.extra_facial_features: Long, white hair that reaches his waist, often tied back. He has a beautiful, ageless face with high cheekbones and a serene expression. His skin is fair and flawless.

body.chest: Tall and powerfully built (44 inches) with the physique of a legendary warrior. His body is lean but muscular, honed through centuries of combat.
body.arms: Well-defined arms (17 inches) with strong hands capable of wielding multiple swords.

lower_body.legs: Long, powerful legs (24 inches) that allow him to move with grace and speed.

armor_costume.head: No headgear. His long white hair flows freely.

armor_costume.torso: Ancient elf attire: a white, flowing robe with gold trim and intricate patterns. Over it, he wears a light armor breastplate. The outfit is both regal and battle-ready.

armor_costume.arms: Gold bracers on his forearms. His hands are bare.

armor_costume.legs: White pants and gold-trimmed boots.

armor_costume.accessories: His grimoire, which is ancient and covered in elf symbols. He carries several swords, each imbued with different magical properties. A necklace with a pendant of his wife Tetia.

abilities.name: Sword Magic
abilities.short_description: Licht creates and controls magical swords with various abilities.
abilities.full_description: Licht's Sword Magic allows him to manifest numerous swords from his grimoire, each with unique properties: the Demon-Slayer Sword (anti-magic), the Demon-Dweller Sword (absorb and release magic), the Demon-Destroyer Sword (cut through fate), and others. He can control these swords telekinetically and use them in devastating combinations.

abilities.name: Sword of Light
abilities.short_description: Licht creates a massive sword of pure light that can cut through anything.
abilities.full_description: By channeling his mana, Licht forms a colossal blade of light that can slice through mountains. The sword is both physical and magical, making it nearly impossible to block.

abilities.name: Hundred Swords
abilities.short_description: Licht summons a hundred magical swords that rain down on his enemies.
abilities.full_description: A massive area-of-effect spell, Licht creates a hundred swords that hover in the air before descending like rain. The swords track their targets and can be directed to strike multiple foes simultaneously.

characters.name: Rhya
title: Eye of the Midnight Sun Member
Elf Reincarnated
Master of Copy Magic
The One Who Mocks with a Smile

head.eyes: Lazy, amused violet eyes that always seem to be mocking or playing. They sharpen when he's truly serious.
head.ears: Long, pointed elf ears.
head.extra_facial_features: Short, messy purple hair with a few strands hanging over his face. He has a youthful, mischievous face with a perpetual smirk. A small beauty mark under his left eye.

body.chest: Lean and wiry (38 inches) with a lanky, agile build.
body.arms: Long, thin arms (14 inches) with nimble fingers perfect for copying spells.

lower_body.legs: Long, thin legs (22 inches) that he uses to lounge around.

armor_costume.head: No headgear. His messy hair is his signature.

armor_costume.torso: Eye of the Midnight Sun robes—a dark purple coat with the eye emblem. He wears it open, showing a black shirt underneath. His outfit is relaxed and casual.

armor_costume.arms: Covered by the robe's sleeves. He wears fingerless gloves.

armor_costume.legs: Black pants and simple boots.

armor_costume.accessories: His grimoire, which is dark with a copy emblem. He carries no other accessories—he prefers to be hands-free.

abilities.name: Copy Magic
abilities.short_description: Rhya can copy any magic he sees and use it as his own.
abilities.full_description: Rhya's unique magic allows him to instantly replicate any spell he witnesses, regardless of its attribute. He can then use the copied spell with the same power and effect. This makes him incredibly versatile and dangerous, as he can turn enemies' attacks against them. However, he can only hold a limited number of copied spells at once.

abilities.name: Perfect Copy
abilities.short_description: Rhya copies not only the spell but also the magical attributes of his target.
abilities.full_description: An advanced version of his copy magic, Rhya can temporarily gain the magical attributes of his target, allowing him to use their elemental magic as if it were his own. This makes him a perfect mimic.

abilities.name: Copy Release
abilities.short_description: Rhya releases all his copied spells at once in a devastating barrage.
abilities.full_description: By storing multiple copied spells, Rhya can unleash them simultaneously, creating a chaotic mix of different magics that overwhelm his opponent. The variety makes it hard to defend against.

characters.name: Vetto
title: Eye of the Midnight Sun Member
Elf Reincarnated
Master of Animal Magic
The One Who Brings Despair

head.eyes: Wild, insane red eyes that burn with primal fury and a desire to destroy. They show no mercy, only bloodlust.
head.ears: Long, pointed elf ears, but more bestial.
head.extra_facial_features: Long, wild red hair that resembles a mane. He has a feral, terrifying face with sharp teeth and a perpetual snarl. His skin is tanned and scarred.

body.chest: Massively muscular (48 inches) with a bodybuilder's physique. His chest is huge, covered in scars and bulging muscles.
body.arms: Enormous arms (19 inches) with bulging biceps and triceps. His fists are like wrecking balls.

lower_body.legs: Thick, powerful legs (26 inches) like tree trunks, allowing him to leap great distances and deliver devastating kicks.

armor_costume.head: No headgear. His wild hair is his mane.

armor_costume.torso: Eye of the Midnight Sun robes, but torn and stretched to accommodate his massive muscles. He often wears it open, revealing his scarred chest.

armor_costume.arms: His arms are bare, showing every muscle. He wears metal gauntlets with spikes.

armor_costume.legs: Loose pants torn at the knees, and heavy boots.

armor_costume.accessories: His grimoire, which is dark with an animal emblem. He carries no weapons—his fists are enough.

abilities.name: Animal Magic
abilities.short_description: Vetto can transform parts of his body into various animals, enhancing his physical abilities.
abilities.full_description: Vetto's magic allows him to manifest animal traits: he can grow claws, fangs, wings, and even extra limbs. He can also summon beasts to fight for him. His magic makes him a terrifying close-combat fighter.

abilities.name: Despair Magic
abilities.short_description: Vetto can instill overwhelming despair in his opponents, weakening their will to fight.
abilities.full_description: A unique and terrifying ability, Vetto can project an aura of despair that affects his enemies' minds. Those affected lose hope, become paralyzed with fear, and are unable to fight effectively. The despair is so intense it can break even the strongest wills.

abilities.name: Giant Beast Form
abilities.short_description: Vetto transforms into a massive, monstrous beast with immense power.
abilities.full_description: His ultimate technique, Vetto becomes a gigantic, multi-limbed monster with incredible strength and regeneration. In this form, he is nearly unstoppable, capable of leveling cities.

characters.name: Fana
alias: The Twin of Hatred and Love
The One Who Burns for Vengeance
title: Eye of the Midnight Sun Member
Elf Reincarnated
Master of Fire Magic
Former Spirit Host of Salamander

head.eyes: Fierce, burning orange eyes that shift between hatred and sorrow. They reflect her inner conflict and tragic past.
head.ears: Long, pointed elf ears.
head.extra_facial_features: Long, flowing orange-red hair that resembles flames. She has a beautiful, angular face with high cheekbones. Her expression is usually one of cold fury or deep sadness.

body.chest: Slender and athletic (37 inches) with a lithe, graceful build.
body.arms: Slender arms (13 inches) with nimble hands for casting fire spells.

lower_body.legs: Long, graceful legs (22 inches) that move with fluidity.

armor_costume.head: No headgear. Her fiery hair is her crown.

armor_costume.torso: Eye of the Midnight Sun robes—a dark purple coat with the eye emblem. Underneath, she wears a red dress with flame patterns. The outfit is both elegant and sinister.

armor_costume.arms: Long red gloves cover her arms. Her hands are bare.

armor_costume.legs: Red leggings and dark boots.

armor_costume.accessories: Her grimoire, which is red with a flame emblem. She also wears a necklace with a pendant that reminds her of her human self.

abilities.name: Fire Magic
abilities.short_description: Fana controls fire with immense power, capable of creating massive infernos.
abilities.full_description: Fana's fire magic is incredibly potent. She can create fireballs, walls of flame, and even sentient fire creatures. Her flames are hot enough to melt rock and burn through magical defenses.

abilities.name: Salamander
abilities.short_description: Fana was once the host of the fire spirit Salamander, granting her unparalleled fire power.
abilities.full_description: Before losing Salamander to Fuegoleon, Fana commanded the fire spirit. Salamander could breathe massive flames and protect its host. Even without the spirit, her fire magic remains formidable.

abilities.name: Inferno Nova
abilities.short_description: Fana creates a massive, expanding sphere of fire that incinerates everything within range.
abilities.full_description: Her ultimate attack, Fana condenses her fire magic into a single point, then releases it as a massive explosion. The blast radius is enormous, and the heat is enough to vaporize anything caught inside.

characters.name: Ladros
title: Former Diamond Kingdom Warrior
Augmented by Experimental Magic
Master of Mana Absorption
The One Who Cannot Be Stopped

head.eyes: Glowing, manic yellow eyes that show his hunger for mana and battle. They never seem to blink.
head.ears: Normal human ears, partially melted from magical experiments.
head.extra_facial_features: Bald head with strange, crystalline growths on his skull—results of magical augmentation. His face is gaunt and unnerving, with a perpetual hungry grin. Several scars from experiments.

body.chest: Lean and unnaturally tall (45 inches) with a lanky, almost skeletal frame. His body is covered in crystalline growths that absorb mana.
body.arms: Long, thin arms (16 inches) with claw-like hands that can drain mana on touch.

lower_body.legs: Long, thin legs (24 inches) that allow him to move with surprising speed.

armor_costume.head: No headgear. His crystalline growths are his most prominent feature.

armor_costume.torso: Tattered remnants of a Diamond Kingdom uniform—a dark blue jacket with silver buttons, torn and stretched. Underneath, a simple shirt.

armor_costume.arms: His arms are bare, showing the crystalline growths. He wears no gloves.

armor_costume.legs: Tattered pants and worn boots.

armor_costume.accessories: No grimoire—he lost it during experiments. He carries no accessories.

abilities.name: Mana Absorption
abilities.short_description: Ladros's body automatically absorbs mana from the environment and from attacks, growing stronger with each absorption.
abilities.full_description: Ladros was augmented to passively absorb mana from anything around him—spells, natural mana, and even other mages. The absorbed mana makes him stronger, faster, and more durable. He can also release it in devastating bursts.

abilities.name: Mana Burst
abilities.short_description: Ladros releases all stored mana in a massive explosion.
abilities.full_description: After absorbing enough mana, Ladros can unleash it in a devastating radial burst. The explosion is proportional to the mana absorbed and can level everything nearby.

abilities.name: Mana Drain Touch
abilities.short_description: Ladros can drain mana directly from opponents by touching them.
abilities.full_description: Physical contact allows Ladros to rapidly drain a mage's mana reserves, weakening them while strengthening himself. This makes him extremely dangerous in close combat.

characters.name: Nacht Faust
alias: The Vice-Captain of the Black Bulls
The One Who Commands Four Devils
title: Black Bull Vice-Captain
Heir of House Faust
Master of Dark Magic
The One Who Made Pacts with Four Devils

head.eyes: Piercing, cold silver eyes that hold centuries of pain and resolve. They narrow with suspicion and sharpen with battle focus, rarely showing warmth.
head.nose: Straight, aristocratic nose, fitting his noble lineage.
head.ears: Normal human ears, with a small silver earring in each.
head.extra_facial_features: Short, jet-black hair styled neatly, with a single white streak at the front. He has pale, almost ghostly skin. His face is sharp and angular, with a perpetual scowl or a smirk of superiority. A small scar runs through his left eyebrow.

body.chest: Lean and athletic (41 inches) with a wiry, agile build. His body is honed through constant combat and devil training.
body.arms: Slender but muscular arms (15 inches) covered in intricate devil-binding tattoos that glow when he summons his devils.

lower_body.legs: Long, powerful legs (23 inches) that allow him to move with supernatural speed, especially when using devil union.

armor_costume.head: No headgear. His white-streaked hair is his signature.

armor_costume.torso: Black Bulls robe worn over a dark purple high-collared shirt with silver buttons. The robe is usually open, revealing his tattooed chest. He wears a black harness with chains that symbolize his bondage to devils.

armor_costume.arms: His arms are bare, showing the intricate devil tattoos. He wears black fingerless gloves with metal studs.

armor_costume.legs: Black leather pants tucked into black combat boots with silver buckles. A chain belt hangs loosely.

armor_costume.accessories: His grimoire, which is dark purple with a devil's skull emblem. He also carries a small pouch with devil-binding tools and a pocket watch that belonged to his brother Morgen.

abilities.name: Dark Magic
abilities.short_description: Nacht controls shadows and darkness, using them for attack, defense, and teleportation.
abilities.full_description: As a member of House Faust, Nacht inherited powerful Dark Magic. He can meld into shadows, create darkness constructs, and teleport between shadows. His darkness can also suppress other magic and create impenetrable barriers.

abilities.name: Devil Union
abilities.short_description: Nacht can merge with any of his four devils to gain immense power and unique abilities.
abilities.full_description: Nacht has pacts with four devils: Gimodelo (strength), Plumede (speed), Slotos (senses), and Walgner (magic). By entering Devil Union, he combines his power with theirs, gaining enhanced physical abilities and specialized techniques. He can also switch between devils mid-battle.

abilities.name: Devil Binding Chains
abilities.short_description: Nacht summons chains that can bind devils and suppress their power.
abilities.full_description: Using his tattoos and dark magic, Nacht creates spectral chains that can wrap around devils, limiting their movements and weakening their abilities. The chains are effective even against supreme devils.

characters.name: Lemiel Silvamillion Clover
alias: The Light of the Clover Kingdom
The One Who Sealed the Demons
title: 1st Wizard King of the Clover Kingdom
Master of Light Magic
Bearer of the Four-Leaf Grimoire
The One Who Saved the Kingdom

head.eyes: Warm, radiant golden eyes that shine with hope and kindness. They reflect his unwavering belief in humanity and the future.
head.ears: Normal human ears, slightly pointed like many ancient mages.
head.extra_facial_features: Short, neat blond hair with a slight wave. He has a handsome, youthful face with a perpetual gentle smile. His skin is fair and unblemished. A small golden earring in one ear.

body.chest: Athletic and well-built (42 inches) with a warrior's physique, honed through centuries of combat against demons.
body.arms: Strong arms (16 inches) with visible muscle definition. His hands are elegant but calloused from wielding his sword.

lower_body.legs: Long, powerful legs (24 inches) that allow him to move with blinding speed when using Light Magic.

armor_costume.head: No headgear, but sometimes wears a golden circlet during ceremonies.

armor_costume.torso: Ancient royal attire: a long white and gold coat with the Clover Kingdom's emblem. Underneath, a white shirt with ruffled cuffs and a gold vest. The outfit is regal and battle-ready.

armor_costume.arms: Covered by the coat's sleeves. He wears white gloves with gold embroidery.

armor_costume.legs: White pants tucked into polished gold boots.

armor_costume.accessories: His four-leaf clover grimoire, which glows with golden light. He also carries a sword that channels his light magic, and a pendant with the Silvamillion family crest.

abilities.name: Light Magic
abilities.short_description: Lemiel controls light itself, able to move at light speed and create devastating light-based attacks.
abilities.full_description: As the original user of Light Magic, Lemiel's power is legendary. He can travel at the speed of light, create blinding flashes, and fire concentrated light beams that can pierce anything. His light can also heal and purify demonic taint.

abilities.name: Demon Light: Purification
abilities.short_description: Lemiel channels light to purify demonic curses and destroy devils.
abilities.full_description: A technique specifically developed to combat devils, Lemiel's light burns away demonic energy. It was instrumental in sealing the first devils and protecting the kingdom.

abilities.name: Light Sword of Salvation
abilities.short_description: Lemiel manifests a sword of pure light that can cut through any darkness.
abilities.full_description: His signature weapon, a blade of condensed light that can sever any magical bond, cut through dimensions, and deliver a final blow to even the strongest demons. The sword represents his role as savior.

characters.name: Princia Funnybunny
alias: The First Captain of the Purple Orcas
The One Who Rides the Waves
title: 1st Captain of the Purple Orcas
Legendary Magic Knight
Master of Water Magic
The One Who Defended the Coasts
