head.eyes: Sharp, determined blue eyes that reflect her unwavering resolve and love for the sea.
head.ears: Normal human ears, with small seashell earrings.
head.extra_facial_features: Long, wavy aquamarine hair that flows like water, often tied in a high ponytail. She has a strong, tanned face with a perpetual confident smile.

body.chest: Athletic and toned (40 inches) with a swimmer's build—broad shoulders and strong core.
body.arms: Well-defined arms (15 inches) from years of swimming and combat.

lower_body.legs: Long, powerful legs (23 inches) built for swimming and fast movement.

armor_costume.head: No headgear. She sometimes wears a bandana with ocean patterns.

armor_costume.torso: Purple Orcas captain's robe—a dark purple coat with silver trim and the orca emblem. Underneath, a blue scale-patterned shirt. The outfit is practical for water combat.

armor_costume.arms: Bare arms showing her muscles. She wears blue wristbands.

armor_costume.legs: Dark blue pants tucked into waterproof boots.

armor_costume.accessories: Her grimoire, which is blue with wave patterns. She carries a trident that channels her water magic.

abilities.name: Water Magic
abilities.short_description: Princia commands water with mastery, able to create tsunamis and control the tides.
abilities.full_description: Her water magic is among the most powerful in history. She can summon massive waves, create water constructs, and even manipulate the weather at sea. Her presence alone calms or stirs the ocean.

abilities.name: Orca Wave
abilities.short_description: Princia creates a massive wave in the shape of an orca that crashes into enemies.
abilities.full_description: Her signature attack, a towering wave that takes the form of a killer whale, capable of destroying ships and sweeping away armies.

characters.name: Jester Garandros
title: Supreme Devil of the Underworld
Master of Illusion Magic
The One Who Delights in Chaos

head.eyes: Wild, mismatched eyes—one crimson, one violet—that swirl with madness and amusement. They never stop moving.
head.nose: Long, exaggerated, like a jester's prosthetic.
head.ears: Pointed devil ears, adorned with small bells.
head.extra_facial_features: Pale white skin with painted black diamonds around his eyes. He has a wide, maniacal grin that never fades. His hair is a mess of purple and red spikes, with small jester hats attached.

body.chest: Lean and unnaturally flexible (40 inches), able to contort in impossible ways.
body.arms: Long, spindly arms (17 inches) with too many joints, ending in gloved hands with sharp claws.

lower_body.legs: Long, thin legs (24 inches) that end in curled shoes with bells.

armor_costume.head: A jester's hat with two floppy horns and bells.

armor_costume.torso: A motley coat of purple and red, with ruffled collar and oversized buttons. The coat is covered in magical illusions that shift patterns.

armor_costume.arms: Long striped sleeves with bells at the cuffs.

armor_costume.legs: Tight striped pants and curled shoes with bells.

armor_costume.accessories: His grimoire, which is a giant playing card. He carries a scepter that doubles as a joke weapon.

abilities.name: Illusion Magic
abilities.short_description: Jester creates reality-bending illusions that trap victims in endless nightmares.
abilities.full_description: His illusions are so powerful they can become semi-real, causing actual harm. He delights in creating impossible scenarios and watching his victims despair.

abilities.name: Joker's Wild
abilities.short_description: Jester unleashes a chaotic barrage of random magical effects, from explosions to transformations.
abilities.full_description: A completely unpredictable attack where anything can happen—enemies might turn into frogs, be launched into the air, or simply vanish. Even Jester doesn't know what will happen.

characters.name: Edward Avalaché
alias: The One Who Nurtured the Kingdom
title: 13th Wizard King of the Clover Kingdom
Master of Plant Magic
The One Who Made the Land Bloom

head.eyes: Calm, wise green eyes that reflect his deep connection to nature.
head.ears: Normal human ears, slightly pointed.
head.extra_facial_features: Long, silver-green hair tied in a low ponytail. He has a kind, weathered face with laugh lines. A small leaf-shaped earring.

body.chest: Lean and healthy (40 inches) from a life of tending plants and fighting.
body.arms: Slender but strong arms (15 inches) with dirt permanently under his nails.

lower_body.legs: Average legs (22 inches), comfortable in nature.

armor_costume.head: No headgear, but sometimes wears a crown of leaves.

armor_costume.torso: A green and brown robe with leaf patterns, the Wizard King's mantle. Underneath, a simple linen shirt.

armor_costume.arms: Covered by the robe's sleeves. He wears gardening gloves when working.

armor_costume.legs: Brown pants and comfortable boots.

armor_costume.accessories: His grimoire, which is green with a tree emblem. He carries a watering can that channels his magic.

abilities.name: Plant Magic
abilities.short_description: Edward controls all plant life, from tiny seeds to ancient trees.
abilities.full_description: He can accelerate plant growth, create living wood constructs, and use plants for attack and defense. His magic also allows him to heal using natural essences.

abilities.name: Forest of Protection
abilities.short_description: Edward summons an entire forest to shield the kingdom.
abilities.full_description: A massive defensive spell that creates an impenetrable forest around the capital, with trees that move and fight to protect the people.

characters.name: Conrad Leto
alias: The One Who Would Save Everyone
title: 28th Wizard King of the Clover Kingdom
Master of Soul Magic
The One Who Tried to Resurrect the Dead

head.eyes: Haunted, dark grey eyes that hold deep sorrow and a desperate hope. They show the weight of his actions.
head.ears: Normal human ears.
head.extra_facial_features: Short, silver-grey hair with a few black streaks. He has a handsome, worn face with a perpetual sad smile. A small scar on his chin.

body.chest: Athletic and lean (42 inches) from years as a Magic Knight.
body.arms: Strong arms (16 inches) with veins visible from straining to hold his power.

lower_body.legs: Powerful legs (23 inches) that once stood firm for the kingdom.

armor_costume.head: No headgear. His grey hair is often messy.

armor_costume.torso: Remnants of the Wizard King's robes—a tattered white and gold coat stained with time. Underneath, a simple black shirt.

armor_costume.arms: Bare arms showing old battle scars. He wears worn leather bracers.

armor_costume.legs: Dark pants and scuffed boots.

armor_costume.accessories: His grimoire, which is grey with a soul emblem. He carries a locket with a picture of those he lost.

abilities.name: Soul Magic
abilities.short_description: Conrad manipulates souls—able to separate, bind, and even resurrect them.
abilities.full_description: Soul Magic is forbidden and incredibly dangerous. Conrad can extract souls from the living, trap them, and even attempt to reanimate the dead. His ultimate goal was to bring back loved ones, but the cost is immense.

abilities.name: Soul Resurrection
abilities.short_description: Conrad attempts to return souls to dead bodies, creating temporary life.
abilities.full_description: A forbidden spell that can reanimate the deceased, but the bodies are unstable and the souls eventually fade. It requires immense life force as payment.

characters.name: Nozel Silva
alias: The One Who Protects His Siblings
title: Captain of the Silver Eagles
First Son of House Silva
Master of Mercury Magic
The One Who Hides His True Feelings

head.eyes: Cold, sharp turquoise eyes that hide deep pain and a fierce protective instinct. They rarely show emotion.
head.ears: Normal human ears, with small silver earrings.
head.extra_facial_features: Long, silvery-white hair tied in a ponytail with a black ribbon. He has a beautiful, angular face with high cheekbones and a perpetual sneer. A small scar above his left eyebrow.

body.chest: Tall and lean (42 inches) with a slender, elegant build. Not bulky, but deceptively strong.
body.arms: Long, graceful arms (16 inches) with mercury tattoos that glow when he uses magic.

lower_body.legs: Long legs (23 inches) that carry him with cold precision.

armor_costume.head: No headgear. His silver hair is his crown.

armor_costume.torso: Silver Eagles captain's robe—a long silver coat with white fur trim and the eagle emblem. Underneath, a black high-collared shirt with silver buttons.

armor_costume.arms: Covered by the robe's sleeves. He wears silver gloves.

armor_costume.legs: Black pants and polished silver boots.

armor_costume.accessories: His grimoire, which is silver with mercury droplets. He carries no visible weapons, relying on his mercury.

abilities.name: Mercury Magic
abilities.short_description: Nozel controls mercury, using it for offense, defense, and binding.
abilities.full_description: Mercury Magic allows Nozel to create liquid metal constructs. He can form blades, shields, and even mercury rain that poisons enemies. His mercury can also harden into solid metal for powerful strikes.

abilities.name: Silver Rain
abilities.short_description: Nozel summons a storm of mercury droplets that pierce and poison everything in range.
abilities.full_description: A deadly area attack where thousands of mercury needles rain down, impossible to dodge. The droplets also seep into wounds, causing internal damage.

abilities.name: Mercury Armor
abilities.short_description: Nozel coats himself in liquid mercury that hardens into protective armor.
abilities.full_description: A defensive spell that encases him in a layer of mercury, which can absorb impacts and reshape to deflect attacks. The armor also allows him to slide across surfaces at high speed.

characters.name: Charlotte Roselei
alias: The One Who Loves in Secret
title: Captain of the Blue Roses
Master of Briar Magic
Afflicted by a Curse
The One Who Yearns for Yami

head.eyes: Large, expressive emerald eyes that can be fierce in battle or soft with hidden affection. They often glance secretly at Yami.
head.ears: Normal human ears, with small blue rose earrings.
head.extra_facial_features: Long, flowing blue hair that reaches her waist, often styled with a braid. She has a beautiful, aristocratic face with fair skin and full lips. Her expression is usually proud and stern, but can blush furiously.

body.chest: Slender and graceful (37 inches) with a feminine figure.
body.arms: Slender arms (13 inches) with nimble hands. She has a small rose tattoo on her wrist.

lower_body.legs: Long, shapely legs (22 inches) that she uses to kick errant males.

armor_costume.head: No headgear. Her blue hair is always perfect.

armor_costume.torso: Blue Roses captain's robe—a long blue coat with silver trim and the rose emblem. Underneath, a white blouse with ruffles and a blue corset.

armor_costume.arms: Covered by the coat's sleeves. She wears blue gloves with rose patterns.

armor_costume.legs: Blue skirt over white tights, and blue heeled boots.

armor_costume.accessories: Her grimoire, which is blue with rose vines. She also carries a small compact mirror and lipstick.

abilities.name: Briar Magic
abilities.short_description: Charlotte creates and controls thorny vines that can bind, cut, and poison.
abilities.full_description: Her briars are nearly unbreakable and can grow rapidly. She can create walls of thorns, entangle enemies, and even use the vines to whip and slice. The thorns are coated with a paralytic toxin.

abilities.name: Blue Rose Thicket
abilities.short_description: Charlotte summons a massive thicket of thorny roses that traps enemies and drains their strength.
abilities.full_description: A forest of blue roses erupts from the ground, ensnaring all within. The roses' thorns inject a weakening poison, and their beauty lulls victims into complacency.

abilities.name: Curse Empowerment
abilities.short_description: Charlotte's curse actually enhances her briar magic, making it more dangerous.
abilities.full_description: The curse placed on her by a devil causes her emotions to strengthen her magic. When she feels strong emotions—especially about Yami—her briars become more powerful and uncontrollable.

characters.name: Dorothy Unsworth
alias: The One Who Lives in Dreams
title: Captain of the Coral Peacocks
Master of Dream Magic
The One Who Can't Stay Awake
The Dream Realm's Ruler

head.eyes: Half-lidded, sleepy violet eyes that rarely open fully. When they do, they show a dreamy, otherworldly intelligence.
head.ears: Normal human ears, hidden by her wild hair.
head.extra_facial_features: Wild, fluffy pink hair that resembles cotton candy, often with sleepwear-themed accessories. She has a round, childish face with a perpetual sleepy smile. A small star-shaped sticker on her cheek.

body.chest: Small and childlike (35 inches) with a soft, cuddly appearance.
body.arms: Short, chubby arms (12 inches) that she often uses to hug pillows.

lower_body.legs: Short legs (19 inches) that she barely uses, preferring to float in dreams.

armor_costume.head: A sleep bonnet with star patterns, or a small nightcap.

armor_costume.torso: A fluffy pajama-like robe in pastel pink and blue, covered in moon and star prints. Over it, she wears the Coral Peacocks robe, often slipping off one shoulder.

armor_costume.arms: Puffy sleeves with lace cuffs. She wears fingerless mittens.

armor_costume.legs: Matching pajama pants and fluffy slippers.

armor_costume.accessories: Her grimoire, which is pink with a dreamcatcher emblem. She always carries a pillow and sometimes a stuffed animal.

abilities.name: Dream Magic
abilities.short_description: Dorothy can manipulate dreams, creating dream worlds and trapping others in them.
abilities.full_description: She can pull people into her dream realm, where she has absolute control. In dreams, she can create anything, and the dream can affect the real world if she wills it. Those trapped may never wake up.

abilities.name: Glamour World
abilities.short_description: Dorothy creates a personal dream dimension where she is god.
abilities.full_description: Her ultimate spell, she manifests a world of her imagination. Within Glamour World, she can alter reality, create impossible creatures, and trap enemies in endless loops. The only way out is if she allows it or if someone has enough willpower to resist.

abilities.name: Dream Eater
abilities.short_description: Dorothy can consume the dreams of others to regain energy and power.
abilities.full_description: She feeds on dreams, both good and bad, using them to sustain herself. This ability also allows her to see into a person's subconscious.

characters.name: Morgen Faust
alias: The One Who Died Too Soon
title: Former Purple Orca Member
Twin Brother of Nacht Faust
Master of Light Magic
The One Who Believed in Justice

head.eyes: Warm, gentle silver eyes that shine with kindness and unwavering faith in humanity.
head.nose: Straight, like his brother's, but softer.
head.ears: Normal human ears, with small silver studs.
head.extra_facial_features: Short, neat black hair with a single white streak, matching Nacht's but reversed. He has a kind, open face with a perpetual gentle smile. No scars.

body.chest: Athletic and lean (40 inches) with the build of a dedicated Magic Knight.
body.arms: Well-defined arms (15 inches) that he used to protect others.

lower_body.legs: Strong legs (22 inches) that carried him into battle.

armor_costume.head: No headgear. His hair is neatly styled.

armor_costume.torso: Purple Orcas uniform—a dark purple coat with silver trim and the orca emblem. Underneath, a white shirt with a cravat.

armor_costume.arms: Covered by the coat's sleeves. He wears white gloves.

armor_costume.legs: Dark pants and polished boots.

armor_costume.accessories: His grimoire, which is light blue with a sun emblem. He carried a pendant with his brother's picture.

abilities.name: Light Magic
abilities.short_description: Morgen wielded light magic, using it for healing and protection.
abilities.full_description: Unlike Lemiel's offensive light, Morgen's light was gentle—he could heal wounds, create barriers, and purify dark influences. He used his magic to save lives, not take them.

abilities.name: Purifying Light
abilities.short_description: Morgen's light could cleanse curses and demonic taint.
abilities.full_description: A rare ability, his light could remove even powerful curses. This made him a target for devils who feared his power.

characters.name: Lily Aquaria
title: Sister of the Hage Church
Master of Water Magic
Childhood Friend of Asta and Yuno
The One Who Chose the Cloth

head.eyes: Warm, caring brown eyes that always hold a gentle smile. They sometimes show sadness for the children she raised.
head.ears: Normal human ears, often hidden by her habit.
head.extra_facial_features: Soft, light brown hair usually hidden under her nun's habit. She has a kind, round face with rosy cheeks. A perpetual gentle smile.

body.chest: Slender and average (36 inches) under her religious robes.
body.arms: Slender arms (13 inches) that she uses to care for children.

lower_body.legs: Average legs (21 inches) that carry her through the church duties.

armor_costume.head: Traditional white nun's habit with a veil.

armor_costume.torso: A long black religious robe with a white collar and a silver cross. Simple and modest.

armor_costume.arms: Covered by the robe's long sleeves. She wears simple gloves when working.

armor_costume.legs: The robe covers her legs. She wears simple black shoes.

armor_costume.accessories: Her grimoire, which is blue with a water drop emblem. She also carries a Bible and a small water flask.

abilities.name: Water Magic
abilities.short_description: Lily can create and control water, mainly used for cleaning and helping around the church.
abilities.full_description: Though not a combat mage, her water magic is useful for everyday tasks—creating clean water, washing, and gentle healing. She could fight if necessary, but prefers peace.

abilities.name: Healing Rain
abilities.short_description: Lily calls a gentle rain that soothes injuries and calms minds.
abilities.full_description: A supportive spell that creates a soft rain with mild healing properties. It can clean wounds and ease pain, but not heal serious injuries.

characters.name: Lolopechka
alias: The Princess of the Heart Kingdom
title: Princess of the Heart Kingdom
Host of the Water Spirit Undine
Master of Water Magic
The One Cursed by Megicula

head.eyes: Large, innocent turquoise eyes that hold deep wisdom and a hidden sadness. They sparkle with curiosity and kindness.
head.ears: Normal human ears, with small pearl earrings.
head.extra_facial_features: Long, flowing aqua hair with natural waves, reaching her waist. She has a beautiful, youthful face with a perpetual gentle smile. A small tiara rests on her head.

body.chest: Slender and graceful (36 inches) with a princess's delicate figure.
body.arms: Slender arms (13 inches) with elegant hands.

lower_body.legs: Long, shapely legs (22 inches) that she uses to walk gracefully through her kingdom.

armor_costume.head: A delicate silver tiara with aquamarine gems.

armor_costume.torso: Royal Heart Kingdom attire—a flowing white and blue dress with water patterns, with a high collar and long flowing sleeves. Over it, a sheer cape with wave embroidery.

armor_costume.arms: Long sheer sleeves with silver bracelets on her wrists.

armor_costume.legs: The dress extends to the ground, with delicate sandals underneath.

armor_costume.accessories: Her grimoire, which is blue with a wave emblem. She also carries a scepter topped with a water droplet.

abilities.name: Water Magic
abilities.short_description: Lolopechka commands water with the help of Undine, able to create massive floods and healing waters.
abilities.full_description: As Undine's host, her water magic is extraordinarily powerful. She can summon tsunamis, create water constructs, and use water for healing and purification. Her magic is gentle but overwhelming when needed.

abilities.name: Curse of Megicula
abilities.short_description: Lolopechka carries a curse that slowly drains her life and will eventually kill her.
abilities.full_description: Placed by the devil Megicula, this curse causes her to gradually lose her memories and life force. It also makes her vulnerable to possession. Despite this, she remains cheerful and determined.

abilities.name: Heart Kingdom's Guardian
abilities.short_description: Lolopechka can create a massive water barrier that protects the entire kingdom.
abilities.full_description: A defensive spell that surrounds the Heart Kingdom with a dome of water, which can repel invaders and purify dark magic. It requires constant concentration but shows her dedication to her people.

characters.name: Undine
alias: The Guardian of the Heart Kingdom
title: Water Spirit of the Heart Kingdom
Companion to the Princess
Embodiment of the Sea
The One Who Purifies

head.eyes: Deep, endless blue eyes that hold the wisdom of the ocean. They are calm and serene.
head.ears: Pointed, fin-like ears.
head.extra_facial_features: Translucent blue skin with a water-like sheen. Her hair flows like water, long and wavy, with small bubbles floating around. She has an ethereal, beautiful face with no visible scars.

body.chest: Graceful and fluid (variable), her body seems to shift like water.
body.arms: Long, flowing arms that sometimes dissipate into mist.

lower_body.legs: Her lower body often trails into a watery mist, as she floats rather than walks.

armor_costume.head: No headgear. Her hair flows like a waterfall.

armor_costume.torso: She wears a dress made of water itself, shifting in color from clear to deep blue. It's ethereal and reveals glimpses of her form.

armor_costume.arms: Water-like sleeves that merge with her body.

armor_costume.legs: No legs—she floats on a current of water.

armor_costume.accessories: She carries no physical objects, but small fish and bubbles often circle her.

abilities.name: Water Spirit Powers
abilities.short_description: As a spirit, Undine can control vast amounts of water and grant her host immense power.
abilities.full_description: Undine can create floods, manipulate water at a molecular level, and purify any liquid. When united with Lolopechka, their combined power is among the strongest in the world.

abilities.name: Purification
abilities.short_description: Undine's water can cleanse curses and dark magic.
abilities.full_description: Her water has natural purifying properties, able to wash away curses and demonic influence. However, Megicula's curse is too strong for her alone.

characters.name: Gadjah
alias: The Shield of the Heart Kingdom
The One Who Served Two Rulers
title: Guardian of the Heart Kingdom
Master of Lightning Magic
Loyal Servant to Lolopechka
The One Who Fought Alongside the Black Bulls

head.eyes: Sharp, electric blue eyes that crackle with energy and alertness. They miss nothing.
head.ears: Normal human ears, with small lightning bolt earrings.
head.extra_facial_features: Short, spiky grey hair with black streaks. He has a weathered, experienced face with a strong jawline and a perpetual serious expression. A scar runs across his left cheek.

body.chest: Broad and muscular (44 inches) with the build of a seasoned warrior. His chest is covered in lightning-shaped scars.
body.arms: Powerful arms (17 inches) with visible veins and muscles.

lower_body.legs: Thick, strong legs (24 inches) built for stability and explosive movement.

armor_costume.head: No headgear, but sometimes wears a headband with the Heart Kingdom symbol.

armor_costume.torso: Traditional Heart Kingdom guardian armor—a blue and silver chest plate over a white tunic, with a flowing cape. The armor has lightning patterns.

armor_costume.arms: Metal gauntlets on his forearms, with lightning motifs.

armor_costume.legs: Blue pants with silver knee guards, and sturdy boots.

armor_costume.accessories: His grimoire, which is blue with lightning bolts. He carries a spear that channels his lightning magic.

abilities.name: Lightning Magic
abilities.short_description: Gadjah commands lightning with precision, able to strike with thunderous force.
abilities.full_description: His lightning magic is both fast and powerful. He can fire bolts, create lightning spears, and even call down storms. His attacks are nearly impossible to dodge.

abilities.name: Thunderous Spear
abilities.short_description: Gadjah hurls a spear of condensed lightning that explodes on impact.
abilities.full_description: His signature attack, a lightning bolt shaped like a spear that pierces through defenses and then detonates, shocking everything nearby.

abilities.name: Lightning Barrier
abilities.short_description: Gadjah creates a ring of lightning that protects allies and shocks enemies.
abilities.full_description: A defensive spell that surrounds him and his allies with a crackling barrier. Anyone who touches it gets a powerful electric shock.

characters.name: Lucius Zogratis
title: Eldest Brother of the Zogratis Siblings
Master of Soul Magic and Time Magic
Host of the Devil Astaroth
The One Who Would Be God

head.eyes: Pale, almost white eyes that hold ancient knowledge and absolute coldness. They see past, present, and future simultaneously.
head.ears: Normal human ears, slightly pointed.
head.extra_facial_features: Long, silvery-white hair that reaches his shoulders, neatly parted. He has a handsome, ageless face with a perpetual calm, knowing smile. His skin is unnaturally pale.

body.chest: Lean and tall (43 inches) with an elegant, almost fragile build—deceptively powerful.
body.arms: Long, slender arms (16 inches) with graceful hands.

lower_body.legs: Long legs (23 inches) that carry him with an unhurried, timeless gait.

armor_costume.head: No headgear. His silver hair is always perfect.

armor_costume.torso: A pristine white robe with gold trim, resembling a high priest's vestments. Over it, a long coat with intricate clock patterns. The outfit is immaculate and divine.

armor_costume.arms: Covered by the robe's sleeves. He wears white gloves with gold embroidery.

armor_costume.legs: White pants and polished white boots.

armor_costume.accessories: His grimoire, which is white with a clock emblem. He carries a staff topped with an hourglass.

abilities.name: Soul Magic
abilities.short_description: Lucius can manipulate souls, including his own and others', allowing him to control life and death.
abilities.full_description: Soul Magic lets him absorb, transfer, and modify souls. He can grant immortality, resurrect the dead, or trap souls forever. It's the foundation of his plans.

abilities.name: Time Magic
abilities.short_description: Through Astaroth, Lucius controls time—able to stop, rewind, and accelerate it.
abilities.full_description: Time Magic allows him to see all possible futures, stop time completely, and even travel through time. He uses this to orchestrate events perfectly.

abilities.name: Perfect Future
abilities.short_description: Lucius has seen every possible future and works to bring about his desired one.
abilities.full_description: His time magic grants him knowledge of all outcomes. He can predict any move and has planned for every contingency, making him nearly impossible to defeat.

characters.name: Zenon Zogratis
title: Member of the Dark Triad
Master of Bone Magic
Host of the Devil Beelzebub
The One Who Defeated the Golden Dawn

head.eyes: Cold, emotionless grey eyes that show no mercy or hesitation. They are empty, like a doll's.
head.ears: Normal human ears, with small bone-like earrings.
head.extra_facial_features: Short, neatly combed silver hair. He has a handsome but expressionless face with a perpetual neutral look. No visible scars.

body.chest: Lean and athletic (41 inches) with a wiry, efficient build.
body.arms: Well-defined arms (15 inches) covered in bone-like patterns from his devil.

lower_body.legs: Average legs (22 inches) that move with quiet precision.

armor_costume.head: No headgear. His silver hair is neatly styled.

armor_costume.torso: Dark Triad uniform—a black coat with silver trim and the Spade Kingdom emblem. Underneath, a white shirt with a high collar. The coat has bone-shaped buttons.

armor_costume.arms: Covered by the coat's sleeves. He wears black gloves.

armor_costume.legs: Black pants and black boots.

armor_costume.accessories: His grimoire, which is black with bone patterns. He carries no visible weapons.

abilities.name: Bone Magic
abilities.short_description: Zenon creates and controls bones, using them as weapons, armor, and projectiles.
abilities.full_description: His bone magic allows him to generate sharp bone spikes, create bone shields, and even reconstruct his own skeleton for enhanced durability. The bones are nearly indestructible.

abilities.name: Beelzebub's Spatial Magic
abilities.short_description: Through his devil, Zenon gains control over space, allowing teleportation and spatial attacks.
abilities.full_description: He can create spatial rifts, teleport, and trap enemies in pocket dimensions. Combined with bone magic, his attacks are unpredictable and deadly.

abilities.name: Bone Prison
abilities.short_description: Zenon surrounds enemies with a cage of unbreakable bones.
abilities.full_description: A cage of bones erupts from the ground, trapping victims inside. The bones slowly close in, crushing everything within.

characters.name: Lucifero
title: Supreme Devil of the Underworld
Master of Gravity Magic
Ruler of the 1st Level
The One Who Seeks to Conquer the Living World

head.eyes: Blazing crimson eyes that burn with absolute authority and malice. They see all mortals as insects.
head.ears: Large, pointed devil ears.
head.extra_facial_features: Pale grey skin with black markings. He has a massive, horned head with multiple curved horns. His face is terrifyingly handsome in a demonic way, with a cruel smile.

body.chest: Colossally muscular (60 inches) with a physique that defies human proportions. His chest is covered in ancient runes.
body.arms: Enormous arms (24 inches) with clawed hands that can crush mountains.

lower_body.legs: Massive legs (30 inches) that root him in place, defying gravity.

armor_costume.head: No headgear—his horns are his crown.

armor_costume.torso: He wears no clothing, only shadows and demonic energy that form a kind of armor. Sometimes, tattered remnants of royal robes.

armor_costume.arms: Bare, showing every muscle and rune.

armor_costume.legs: His lower body fades into shadow.

armor_costume.accessories: None—he needs no tools.

abilities.name: Gravity Magic
abilities.short_description: Lucifero controls gravity itself, able to crush anything or even reverse gravity.
abilities.full_description: His gravity magic is absolute. He can increase gravity to crush enemies into nothing, create black holes, or fling objects into space. No one can move freely in his presence.

abilities.name: Demon King's Authority
abilities.short_description: As the supreme devil, his presence alone weakens all other magic.
abilities.full_description: Any magic used near him is suppressed, and devils weaker than him are forced to submit. His aura causes fear and despair in all living things.

head.eyes: Eyes that contain swirling galaxies and clock faces—they see past, present, and future simultaneously.
head.ears: Pointed devil ears with clockwork gears.
head.extra_facial_features: Skin that seems to shift between ages—sometimes young, sometimes ancient. His face is serene and knowing, with a slight smile. Multiple clock hands orbit his head.

body.chest: Lean and ethereal (42 inches), partially transparent, showing gears inside.
body.arms: Long arms with clockwork joints, ending in delicate hands.

lower_body.legs: His lower body dissolves into a mist of time.

armor_costume.head: A crown of floating clock hands.

armor_costume.torso: Robes made of woven time—shifting between past and future forms.

armor_costume.arms: Covered in clockwork patterns.

armor_costume.legs: No legs—he floats.

armor_costume.accessories: A giant hourglass that floats behind him.

abilities.name: Time Magic
abilities.short_description: Astaroth has absolute control over time, able to manipulate timelines.
abilities.full_description: He can stop, rewind, fast-forward, and even alter the flow of time for individuals or entire worlds. He sees all possible futures and chooses which to manifest.

abilities.name: Temporal Loops
abilities.short_description: Astaroth traps enemies in endless time loops, forcing them to relive moments forever.
abilities.full_description: Victims are caught in a repeating moment, unable to escape or die. Only those with immense willpower can break free.

characters.name: Megicula
title: Supreme Devil of Curses
Master of Curse Magic
The One Who Cursed the Heart Kingdom
The One Who Devours Hope

head.eyes: Malevolent purple eyes with slit pupils, radiating pure malice and satisfaction in suffering.
head.nose: Small, but her face is often obscured by shadows.
head.ears: Long, pointed devil ears.
head.extra_facial_features: Pale purple skin with black curse marks covering her face. She has long, dark purple hair that writhes like snakes. A cruel smile constantly plays on her lips.

body.chest: Feminine and elegant (39 inches) but covered in cursed tattoos.
body.arms: Long arms with clawed fingers, each nail a different curse symbol.

lower_body.legs: Long legs that end in hoofed feet.

armor_costume.head: No headgear. Her hair moves on its own.

armor_costume.torso: A dark purple dress made of cursed energy, with patterns of screaming faces. It's both beautiful and horrifying.

armor_costume.arms: Long gloves made of shadow.

armor_costume.legs: The dress covers her legs.

armor_costume.accessories: A staff topped with a cursed eye.

abilities.name: Curse Magic
abilities.short_description: Megicula creates curses that afflict victims with endless suffering, from pain to death.
abilities.full_description: Her curses are nearly impossible to break. She can curse individuals, bloodlines, or even entire kingdoms. The curses manifest as physical and spiritual torment.

abilities.name: Cursed Resurrection
abilities.short_description: Megicula can resurrect the dead as cursed puppets bound to her will.
abilities.full_description: She brings back the deceased, but they are twisted into monsters that serve her. Their souls are trapped forever.

characters.name: Beelzebub
alias: The One Who Dwells in Voids
title: Supreme Devil of Space
Master of Spatial Magic
The One Who Consumes Dimensions
The Infinite Hunger

head.eyes: Compound insectoid eyes that reflect countless dimensions.
head.nose: None—his face is smooth with insect-like mandibles.
head.ears: None—he senses through spatial vibrations.
head.extra_facial_features: His head resembles a fly, with multiple lenses and antennae. He has a perpetual buzzing sound.

body.chest: Insectoid torso with chitinous armor, black and green.
body.arms: Four arms, each ending in clawed hands.

lower_body.legs: Long, spindly insect legs.

armor_costume.head: No headgear—his fly head is natural.

armor_costume.torso: Natural chitin armor.

armor_costume.arms: Chitin-covered.

armor_costume.legs: Chitin-covered.

armor_costume.accessories: None.

abilities.name: Spatial Magic
abilities.short_description: Beelzebub controls all aspects of space—tearing, folding, and creating dimensions.
abilities.full_description: He can open portals anywhere, trap enemies in pocket dimensions, and even erase space itself. His attacks are impossible to predict.

abilities.name: Void Consumption
abilities.short_description: Beelzebub creates voids that consume everything—matter, magic, and light.
abilities.full_description: A black hole-like sphere that expands, consuming all it touches. Nothing escapes.

characters.name: Zagred
alias: The One Who Orchestrated the Elf Massacre
title: Supreme Devil of Words
Master of Word Magic
The One Who Manipulates Reality
The One Who Hides in Shadows

head.eyes: Deep purple eyes that glow with cunning and malice. They constantly scan for weaknesses.
head.ears: Pointed devil ears, adorned with small rings.
head.extra_facial_features: Pale skin with dark purple markings. He has a mocking smile and a pointed chin. His hair is wild and black with purple highlights.

body.chest: Lean and agile (41 inches) with a dancer's build.
body.arms: Long arms with clawed fingers that gesture dramatically.

lower_body.legs: Long legs, always moving.

armor_costume.head: No headgear. His hair is wild.

armor_costume.torso: A dark purple and black outfit with flowing robes, covered in written words that constantly shift.

armor_costume.arms: Long sleeves with written patterns.

armor_costume.legs: Tight pants and boots.

armor_costume.accessories: His grimoire, which is black with a mouth emblem.

abilities.name: Word Magic
abilities.short_description: Zagred's words become reality—anything he says can manifest.
abilities.full_description: By speaking, he can create anything: weapons, barriers, even concepts like death or sleep. His magic is limited only by his vocabulary and imagination.

abilities.name: Reality Manipulation
abilities.short_description: Zagred can alter reality by describing it.
abilities.full_description: He can say "the sky is red" and it becomes red. He can say "your heart stops" and it stops. Only those with strong will or anti-magic can resist.

characters.name: Liebe
title: Devil of the Five-Leaf Grimoire
Source of Anti-Magic
The One Who Avenged His Mother
The One Who Chose Asta

head.eyes: Large, expressive red eyes that show a surprising range of emotion—anger, sadness, loyalty, and a deep-seated hatred for other devils.
head.ears: Small, pointed devil ears.
head.extra_facial_features: Black skin with red markings. He has a small, horned head with two curved horns. His face is youthful and often scowling or determined. A small mouth with sharp teeth.

body.chest: Small and wiry (30 inches) with a child-like build, but immensely powerful due to anti-magic.
body.arms: Thin arms with clawed hands.

lower_body.legs: Short legs with cloven hooves.

armor_costume.head: No headgear—his horns are natural.

armor_costume.torso: He wears no clothes, only a tattered loincloth. His body is covered in red markings.

armor_costume.arms: Bare.

armor_costume.legs: Bare.

armor_costume.accessories: He lives inside Asta's grimoire and has no physical possessions.

abilities.name: Anti-Magic
abilities.short_description: Liebe's body and very existence negate magic, making him the only devil immune to magic.
abilities.full_description: Anti-Magic flows through him, canceling any magical effect it touches. This power was given to him by the five-leaf grimoire and is the reason he can never be controlled by other devils.

abilities.name: Devil Union with Asta
abilities.short_description: Liebe can merge with Asta, granting him immense anti-magic power and new forms.
abilities.full_description: When they unite, Asta gains Liebe's full power, manifesting black wings, horns, and incredible speed and strength. Their bond is unique among devil-host relationships.
